A chilling vision of the house of Saddam. The world of Hussein comes to life through the eyes of the man who was given a choice; either be the double for Saddam's sadistic son, or die.
After the child of wealthy parents gets abducted, the police and a member of the press intervene to assist the parents in their search but end up complicating their impending decisions.

A group of friends stumble upon a mirror that serves as a portal to a "multiverse", but soon discover that importing knowledge from the other side in order to better their lives brings increasingly dangerous consequences.
In the 25th century, a time when people have designations instead of names, a man, THX 1138, and a woman, LUH 3417, rebel against their rigidly controlled society.
High school loner Bird Fitcher has no idea what dark secrets are tied to the Polaroid camera she finds. It doesn't take long to discover that those who have their picture taken with it, soon die.
Three stories are connected by a Memphis hotel and the spirit of Elvis Presley.
A businesswoman is pursued by a psychopath after being locked in a parking garage on Christmas Eve.
Targeted for his caste, a first-year student at an elite college fights off vicious bullies and lethal threats to protect his dignity and forbidden love.
A young girl tries to understand how she mysteriously gained the power to set things on fire with her mind.
A cop from the provinces moves to Paris to join the Anti-Crime Brigade of Montfermeil, discovering an underworld where the tensions between the different groups mark the rhythm.
A man is murdered in an isolated chalet, and the eight female residents are all suspects; their secrets are revealed as they try to determine who is guilty.

A shy 16-year-old girl learns that she comes from a fabled royal family of legendary sea krakens and that her destiny lies in the depths of the waters, which is bigger than she could have ever imagined.
Donnie Darko's little sister Samantha and her best friend Corey are on a cross-country road trip, but soon find themselves entangled in a dangerous glitch in the time-space continuum.
A naive elderly British rural couple survive the initial onslaught of a nuclear war.
Set against the backdrop of boxing at the Naval Academy, centers on a young man from the wrong side of the tracks whose dream of attending Annapolis becomes a reality.

A socially inept fourteen-year-old experiences heartbreak for the first time when his two best friends - Cappie, an older-brother figure, and Maggie, the new girl with whom he is in love - fall for each other.
When the world is threatened by an ancient evil, the Ninja Turtles must reunite and overcome their faults in order to stand against it.

In all of Roman territory, the village where Asterix and Obelix live is the only enclave that has not yet been dominated by the empire, thanks to the magic potion of the druid Panoramix. But Commander Detritus has a plan to change that.
Kermit and his friends go to New York City to get their musical on Broadway only to find it's a more difficult task than they anticipated.
Pierrot escapes his boring society and travels from Paris to the Mediterranean Sea with Marianne, a girl chased by hit-men from Algeria. They lead an unorthodox life, always on the run.
Jenna is a pregnant, unhappily married waitress in the deep south. She meets a newcomer to her town and falls into an unlikely relationship as a last attempt at happiness.
A troubled young man is drawn to a mythical place called Midian where a variety of friendly monsters are hiding from humanity. Meanwhile, a sadistic serial killer is looking for a patsy.
After being banished from the most popular sorority on campus, Sydney White teams up with a group of socially awkward outcasts to outdo the queen at her own game.
Teenage boys discover discipline and camaraderie on an ill-fated sailing voyage.
A woman planning to testify against the mob must be protected against potential assassins on the train trip from Chicago to Los Angeles.
Walter Van Tilburg Clark's novel inspires an account of a lynch mob that seeks revenge for a rancher's murder.

movies.primaryTitle: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - Tsuzumi Mansion Arc
movies.plot: Tanjiro ventures to the south-southeast where he encounters a cowardly young man named Zenitsu Agatsuma. He is a fellow survivor from Final Selection and his sparrow asks Tanjiro to help keep him in line.
When Nicole comes in contact with Father Anton (Corneliu Ulici) more and more inexplicable events occur. The pair begin to believe that the priest lost the battle with a demon.

With his partner executed in broad daylight by a psychotic mafia enforcer, a veteran Brooklyn officer vows revenge. But is the unstoppable detective prepared to face the truth and pay the price of blood?
A pro tennis player has lost his ambition and has fallen in rank to 119. Fortunately for him, he meets a young player on the women's circuit who helps him recapture his focus for Wimbledon.

A love triangle featuring the trophy girlfriend of a petty drug lord, caught up in a web of luxury and violence in a modern dark gangster tale set in the beautiful port city of Bodrum on the Turkish Riviera.
An orphaned young man in India pursues his dream of becoming a writer while navigating life's challenges and personal growth.
A young girl comes to an embittered town and confronts its attitude with her determination to see the best in life.
The young apprentice of a magical, eccentric toy store owner learns to believe in herself, and in her friends, upon learning some grave news about the future.
Explores the life and legacy of Mariska Hargitay's mother, Hollywood icon Jayne Mansfield, who died tragically in a car accident at age 34 when Mariska was only three years old.
A robbery homicide investigation triggers a series of events that will cause a corrupt LAPD officer to question his tactics.
Frank James continues to avoid arrest in order to take revenge on the Ford brothers for their murder of his brother Jesse.
Three men attempt to make a living in Prohibitionist America after returning home from fighting together in World War I.
Inspired by her mom's rebellious past and a confident new friend, a shy 16-year-old publishes an anonymous zine calling out sexism at her school.

movies.originalTitle: Ging chaat goo si juk jaap
movies.plot: The Hong Kong supercop must stop a group of blackmailing bombers, while the villains of Police Story (1985) are out for revenge.
A young boy with stunted growth is convinced that God has a great purpose for him.
Follows Heather and Carla, who meet after having not spoken in years. Heather is about to present a very unexpected proposition that could change their lives forever.
The story of Indian Space Research Organization scientist Nambi Narayanan, who was framed for being a spy and arrested in 1994.

movies.originalTitle: Eiga Doraemon: Nobita no Esekai Monogatari
movies.plot: Set in the magnificent world of medieval Europe depicted in paintings. Doraemon and his friends jump into the "world of the painting" joined by Claire and her friends Milo and Chai as they emabark on a great adventure!.
In efforts to construct perfect android killing machines in a war against China, UK scientists exceed their goal and create a sentient robot.
In 1870, a gang robs a train and steals a ceremonial Japanese sword meant as a gift for the U.S. President, prompting a manhunt to retrieve it.

When the old owner of a dilapidated used car lot dies due to foul play, his young and ambitious hot-shot salesman and colleagues vow to save the property from falling into the hands of the owner's treacherous brother and used-car rival.
Rancher Wil Andersen is forced to hire inexperienced boys as cowhands in order to get his cattle herd to market on time but the rough drive is full of dangers and a gang of rustlers is trailing them.
A burned-out professional sniper finds himself trapped in an all-glass penthouse by a lethal competitor and must find a way to survive and escape with little to no cover between him and the killer.
After being released from prison, notorious thief Roy Earle is hired by his old boss to help a group of inexperienced criminals plan and carry out the robbery of a California resort.
A teenager with an immune system risks everything to try and make it to Niagara Falls in order to save the girl of his dreams from marrying the wrong man.
A couple's argument over a coffee table spirals into chaos when a simple mistake turns into a desperate web of lies, panic, deception, and the terrifying consequences of trying to cover up the truth.
Billy the Kid and his band of outlaws are pursued across New Mexico territory by Sheriff Pat Garrett, who the young gunslingers must face-off with if they are to reach the safety of the border.
A man convicted of murdering his wife escapes from prison and works with a woman to try to prove his innocence.

Pauli is a sexually frustrated young man who's surrounded by sexually liberated women who will not give him the time of day. He meets a beautiful virgin woman, Andrea, who strongly resists his charms, which compounds his frustrations.
Life for New England realtor Hildy Good begins to unravel when she hooks up with an old high school flame. Based on Ann Leary's 'The Good House.'
A brain surgeon marries a femme fatale whose life he saved, causing his life to turn upside down. Things go even more awry when he falls in love with a telepathic brain.
A Brooklyn teenager spends his days experimenting with drugs and looking online for older men to meet.
An old gunslinger and his daughter must face the consequences of his past, when the son of a man he murdered years ago arrives to take his revenge.
When a copycat serial killer strikes, two detectives ask a convicted felon for help.
A surgeon is assigned the case of a young woman whose aunt wants her lobotomized to cover up a family secret.
An ex-con reunites with his estranged wayward 17-year old daughter to protect her from drug dealers who are trying to kill her.
A school teacher is woken by a sound that fills him with dread.

Inspired by real events in the life of French New Wave icon Jean Seberg. In the late 1960s, Hoover's FBI targeted her because of her political and romantic involvement with civil rights activist Hakim Jamal.

movies.primaryTitle: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
movies.originalTitle: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge on the Run
movies.plot: After SpongeBob's beloved pet snail Gary is snail-napped, he and Patrick embark on an epic adventure to the Lost City of Atlantic City to bring Gary home.
When the crew of the Enterprise learn of a Federation conspiracy against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Captain Picard begins an open rebellion.
An elderly gentleman, haunted by a brutal murder, embarks on a quest for vengeance, navigating a complex web of emotions and moral dilemmas.
A stray cat guides us through each tale in this Stephen King-based anthology horror film.
The lives of the residents of a Brazilian apartment building and the security guards who get the job guarding the surrounding streets.
A brave young man is thrust into adulthood as he and his courageous team of sled dogs embark on a grueling and treacherous cross-country marathon.
An ex-con drifter with a penchant for brawling is amused by a homeless ex-sailor, so they partner up as they head east together.
The life and death story of The Notorious B.I.G. (a.k.a. Christopher Wallace), who came straight out of Brooklyn to take the world of rap music by storm.

Lazy, uneducated students share a very close bond. They live together in the dormitory, where they plan their latest pranks. When a new headmaster arrives, the students naturally try to overthrow him. A comic war of nitwits follows.
In 1940, after watching and being traumatized by the movie Frankenstein (1931), a sensitive seven-year-old girl living in a small Spanish village drifts into her own fantasy world.
A high-end courier has three hours to transport a liver from Brisbane to the Gold Coast.

In 1980 New York, three young men who were all adopted meet each other and find out they're triplets who were separated at birth. But their quest to find out why turns into a bizarre and sinister mystery.
Nicky is on the run from the mob, and he turns to old pal Mikey for help.
A feud develops between two air traffic controllers: one cocky and determined while the other is restrained and laidback, which inevitably affects their lives.
When The Patient wakes up in a hospital without knowing what happened to him, he is issued a life he doesn't remember. But he begins to suspect he's being manipulated.
Raw drama where laughs and emotion crash into stark realities. Earthbound stories pulse with defiance, human spirit, and hope.
A chronicle of the life and Presidency of George W. Bush.
15 months after being stabbed 9 times by a student at work as a high school teacher in NYC, Mr. Garfield is working in LA as a substitute teacher come full-time. He refuses to be a victim anymore.

Lucas and Clementine live peacefully in their isolated country house, but one night they wake up to strange noise... they're not alone... and a group of hooded assailants begin to terrorize them throughout the night.
After the loss of her tormented mother, the erratic behavior of a 15th century woman living in an isolated mountain village becomes a threat to the safety of her infant child.
A troubled kid inadvertently releases a genie, who must grant him any three wishes he requests.

A woman attempts to reunite her family by helping her husband escape prison and together kidnapping their son. But things don't go as planned when they are forced to take a police hostage on the road.

Jagna is a young woman determined to forge her own path in a late 19th century Polish village - a hotbed of gossip and on-going feuds, held together, rich and poor, by adherence to colorful traditions and deep-rooted patriarchy.

movies.primaryTitle: The Storied Life of A.J. Fikry
movies.originalTitle: The Storied Life of A.J. Fikry
movies.plot: A.J. Fikry's wife has died, his bookstore is in trouble, and now his prized rare edition of Poe poems has been stolen. However, when a mysterious package appears, its arrival gives him the chance to start his life over and see things anew.
Biopic of the influential chef, writer, and travel journalist Anthony Bourdain.

A young and ambitious female doctor's best friend falls into an unexplained coma after a routine medical procedure. Noticing an unusually high number of similar comas occurring in her hospital, she's determined to uncover the cause.

Professional thief Mason attempts his biggest heist with his brother, robbing a bank. When it goes wrong, they're trapped inside surrounded by law enforcement. Tension rises as Mason negotiates with his ex-lover, the lead negotiator.
Rahul loses his fans and fame due to alcoholism. But he then decides to turn a small time singer into a rising star.
Detective Shaw discovers a serial killer has buried his son alive and must solve three murders to find him before he dies.
Follows the lives of the Charles family as they deal with themes of family legacy and more, in deciding what to do with an heirloom, the family piano.

movies.primaryTitle: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
movies.originalTitle: Chicken Run: Dawn of the Nugget
movies.plot: Having pulled off an escape from Tweedy's farm, Ginger has found a peaceful island sanctuary for the whole flock. But back on the mainland the whole of chicken-kind faces a new threat, and Ginger and her team decide to break in.
An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

Mumble's son, Erik, is struggling to realize his talents in the Emperor Penguin world. Meanwhile, Mumble and his family and friends discover a new threat their home -- one that will take everyone working together to save them.
Chuck wants to leave home but can't make the grade for boarding school. Then he finds out the disfigured recluse living nearby is an ex-teacher.

The Brothers Bloom are the best con men in the world, swindling millionaires with complex scenarios of lust and intrigue. Now they've decided to take on one last job - showing a beautiful and eccentric heiress the time of her life with a romantic adventure that takes them around the world.

A musical about the victory of love over the trickery of the Devil. A little devil Pinciukas is expelled from Hell and arrives to Baltaragis mill. In exchange for the mill owner's soul and the promise to have his daughter Jurga as a bride he helps the man with his work.
A Los Angeles Rams quarterback, accidentally taken away from his body by an overanxious angel before he was meant to die, returns to life in the body of a recently murdered millionaire.
Along India's Ganges River, four people face prejudice, a strict moral code and a punishing caste system as they confront personal tragedies.
A money collector for a private investigator is hired to track down 10 million dollars stolen in a dodgy real estate deal, opening a complex can of worms.
A giant thirty-five-foot shark becomes trapped in a SeaWorld theme park and it's up to the sons of police chief Brody to rescue everyone.
A woman searching for a spark finds a whirlwind night of romance with a man only to discover he is terminally ill and commits to helping him spend his last days living life to the fullest.
An undercover cop finds it difficult to play both a cop and a goon.

A young girl finds herself in a reform school after therapy since she was blamed for the death of a young boy. At the school she finds herself drawn to a fellow student, unaware that he is an angel, and has loved her for thousands of years.
College philosophy professor Mr. Radisson's curriculum is challenged by his new student, Josh, who believes God exists.
A lonely mother begins receiving romantic e-mails from a secret admirer, unaware that this perfect man is really a creation of her daughter who is trying to cheer her up.

After a run-in with the law, Haley is forced to return to the world from which she fled years ago. Enrolled in an elite gymnastics program run by the legendary Burt Vickerman, Haley's rebellious attitude slowly gives way to a team spirit.

Katherine Parr, the sixth wife of King Henry VIII, is named regent while the tyrant battles abroad. When the king returns, increasingly ill and paranoid, Katherine finds herself fighting for her own survival.

movies.primaryTitle: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
movies.originalTitle: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
movies.plot: A young man searches for home in the changing city that seems to have left him behind.
Follows a woman as her life gets upended when an engagement ring that was for someone else leads her to the person she's meant to be with.
A snowstorm brings a group of young people together in a small town on Christmas Eve.
A vacationing family discovers that the entire town they're visiting is inhabited by goblins, disguised as humans, who plan to eat them.
A group of thieves, that prey on the affluent millennial society, gets more than they bargained for, when they encounter an adversary more formidable than they could've imagined.
Six Californians start a club to discuss the works of Jane Austen, only to find their relationships -- both old and new -- begin to resemble 21st century versions of her novels.
A tough New York City ex-cop relentlessly searches for his kidnapped teenage daughter who is held by a twisted psycho after mistaking her for the daughter of a wealthy businessman.

A romantic dreamer faces reality when forced to work at a matchmaking agency under a practical boss. After learning love needs effort, he loses his chance. Years later, fate offers another opportunity.

When a terrorist bombing in North Africa kills 19 incl. an American, an Egyptian chemical engineer flying from South Africa to his wife in USA, is arrested upon arriving USA. He disappears. His wife asks senator for help.
The almost-human son of "Brundlefly" searches for a cure to his mutated genes while being monitored by a nefarious corporation that wishes to continue his father's experiments.

Neil Jordan's historical biopic of Irish revolutionary Michael Collins, the man who led a guerrilla war against the UK, helped negotiate the creation of the Irish Free State, and led the National Army during the Irish Civil War.
A man travelling to Rameswaram via Chennai express for his late grandfather's ashes immersion finds himself in trouble after helping a don's daughter and her cousins board the train.

Impoverished Persephone marries reclusive Duke, hoping his wealth rescues her family. She persists in connecting with the man beneath his scarred psyche and imposing estate. Grave peril forces him to risk vulnerability to protect her.
A psychosomatically blind, deaf, and mute boy becomes a master pinball player and, subsequently, the figurehead of a cult.
Two parents deal with the effects when their son is accused of murdering his girlfriend.

A small research team went down below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole was hiding. What they have found turned out to be the greatest threat in history. And the future of humanity is in their hands.
Jon, a young wanna-be musician, discovers he's bitten off more than he can chew when he joins an eccentric pop band led by the mysterious and enigmatic Frank.

Two bumbling store clerks inadvertently erase the footage from all of the tapes in their video rental store. In order to keep the business running, they re-shoot every film in the store with their own camera, with a budget of zero dollars.
A reformed bank robber is taken hostage by a desperate man during a bank hold up, but is forced to go on the run with his captor when they're both mistakenly thought to be in cahoots.
Based on the true life story of a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with her military combat dog saved many lives during their deployment in Iraq.
The story of the Operation Bernhard, the largest counterfeiting operation in history, carried out by Germany during World War II.
A man seeks refuge in a remote Indian mountain mansion, fleeing his past. He discovers the house harbors sinister secrets, pain, and terror ready to torment him.
Colin Clark, an employee of Sir Laurence Olivier, documents the tense interactions between Olivier and Marilyn Monroe during the production of The Prince and the Showgirl (1957).
Recently released from a mental hospital, Karin rejoins her emotionally disconnected family in their island home, only to slip from reality as she begins to believe she is being visited by God.

In 2025, as MLB's Dodgers and Cubs clash in Tokyo for a historic season opener, their games become a lens into Japan's passionate baseball culture and the values that bind two nations through America's pastime.

Princess Shizu was born under a terrible curse. Only the eight legendary samurai, hailing from across Japan, can protect her from an ancient supernatural clan to fulfill their destinies as foretold by prophecy.
An innocent man becomes one of the most wanted criminals the world has ever known.
Hitman seeks revenge on a police officer turned District Attorney.
Three adopted English brothers join the French Foreign Legion in North Africa after one of them steals their adoptive family's famous heirloom sapphire.
A woman tries to find her way home with her newborn while an environmental crisis submerges London in floodwaters.

During World War I, a patriotic young American is rendered blind, deaf, limbless, and mute by a horrific artillery shell attack. Trapped in what's left of his body, he desperately looks for a way to end his life.

Morticia and Gomez are distraught that Wednesday and Pugsley are growing up. To reclaim their bond they decide to cram the family into their haunted camper and hit the road for one last vacation together.
Stranded in Colorado after a devastating holiday revelation, a talented but overlooked NYC designer finds unexpected love, transforming her life and career path.
The story of sister and brother, Kate and Teddy Pierce, whose Christmas Eve plan to catch Santa Claus on camera turns into an unexpected journey that most kids could only dream about.
After a chance encounter with a man forgotten from his youth, Fred literally and metaphorically journeys into his past.
A fading matinee idol helps a young singer and actress find fame, even as age and alcoholism send his own career on a downward spiral.
The arrival of Patrick into Marion and Tom's home triggers the exploration of seismic events from 40 years previously.

A debt collector has no other choice than to spend the night in a haunted temple, where he encounters a female ghost, whom he falls in love with. To save her soul he must work with a monk to defeat the tree demon who owns her spirit.
A young woman finds her already unstable life rocked by the presence of a rambunctious imaginary friend from childhood.
A young man, who believes himself to be a vampire, goes to live with his elderly and hostile cousin in a small Pennsylvanian town, where he tries to suppress his blood-lust.
A television newswoman picks up the story of a 1960s rock band whose long-lost leader Eddie Wilson may still be alive, while searching for the missing tapes of the band's never-released album.

movies.originalTitle: Mâo Hé Lâoshâ: Xîng Pán Qí Yuán
movies.plot: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find a magical object and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.
Set in a world with memory recording implants, Alan Hakman is a cutter, someone with the power of final edit over people's recorded histories. His latest assignment is one that puts him in danger.
A young man carrying a big basket that contains his extremely deformed, formerly conjoined twin brother seeks vengeance on the doctors who separated them against their will.
A biographical drama about President Theodore Roosevelt.
An examination on the effect of Franco-era religious schooling and sexual abuse on the lives of two longtime friends.
An all too uptight FBI agent must protect a larger than life mobster with a heart of gold, currently under witness protection in the suburbs.
Dedicated schoolteacher Theresa Dunn spends her nights cruising bars, looking for males with whom she can engage in progressively dangerous extreme sexual encounters.

Twenty-year-old Matsuri Takabayashi learns that she only has ten years to live due to an incurable disease. She decides to not dwell on her life and not to fall in love, but she meets Kazuto Manabe at a school reunion.
A publicist tries to cover up a feud between movie stars.
A high-school student feels responsible for a fatal traffic accident and tries to make amends.
A medieval knight and his servant ask a familiar wizard to move them back in time to prevent father-in-law's accidentally killing. Instead, they fly away to the 20th century.
After her mother commits suicide, a young woman travels to Italy in search of love, truth and a deeper connection with herself.
The story of the 1980 tennis rivalry between the placid Björn Borg and the volatile John McEnroe.
A seemingly ordinary family actually has a dark secret: they are vampires. They choose not to drink blood despite their natural cravings, but their truth is revealed one day.
An attorney in Washington D.C. battles against cynicism, bureaucracy and politics to help the victims of 9/11.
When a family moves to a country home, the young girls experience strange happenings that have a link to an occult event years past.

After realizing that all world is spoiled, Marie and Marie are committed to be spoiled themselves. They rip off older men, feast in lavish meals and do all kinds of mischief. But what is all this leading to?
Jane Fairchild, a maidservant for the Niven family, is surprised when her wealthy neighbor, Paul Sheringham, invites her to spend the day with him.
A family gathers together for a commemorative ritual whose nature only gradually becomes clear.
Over the summer, a series of unfortunate happenings triggers a financial crisis for a young woman and she soon finds her life falling apart.
When a cop who is just out of rehab takes the graveyard shift in a city hospital morgue, she faces a series of bizarre, violent events caused by an evil entity in one of the corpses.
An Internal Affairs agent becomes obsessed with bringing down a cop who has managed to maintain a spotless reputation despite being involved in a web of corruption.
Follows the Carroll siblings on their mission to find answers about their father's mysterious disappearance 58 years ago.
During the Nazi occupation of Rome in 1944, the Resistance leader, Giorgio Manfredi, is chased by the Nazis as he seeks refuge and a way to escape.

Four teenagers discover an underground fallout shelter thanks to a friend, who agrees to have them hide there with the door locked for a few days to escape a school trip. Yet, time passes, and their friend doesn't come back to get them.

GRINGO, a dark comedy mixed with white-knuckle action and dramatic intrigue, explores the battle of survival for businessman Harold Soyinka (David Oyelowo) when he finds himself crossing the line from law-abiding citizen to wanted criminal.

A vengeful spirit has taken the form of the Tooth Fairy to exact vengeance on the town that lynched her 150 years earlier. Her only opposition is the only child, now grown up, who has survived her before.
A desperate man tries to find out why his beloved left him years ago.
In the late 1980s, a low level gangster named Jackie DiNorscio defends himself in court in what became the longest criminal trial in American judicial history.
A clerical mistake results in a bumbling Indian film star being invited to an exclusive Hollywood party instead of being fired.
A modern-day take on the "Beauty and the Beast" tale where a New York teen is transformed into a hideous monster in order to find true love.

The unemployed engineer Kenneth devotes all his time to building hobby models. On his way to an imposed job interview, he crosses paths with marine biologist Sten, who offers him work as an assistant at his shipyard. Kenneth's heavily pregnant partner Marta breathes a sigh of relief. But what starts as a simple paint job on a boat hull and some routine sorting slowly draws Kenneth into an increasingly complex and elusive investigation.
A bad deed on the part of a tough minor-league hockey player results in an unusual sentence: He must serve one week as a real-life tooth fairy.

A team of special agents discovers a revolutionary new computer program to bait and trap online predators. After teaming up with the program's troubled developer, they soon find that the AI is rapidly advancing beyond its original purpose.
A widow accepts a job as a live-in governess to the King of Siam's children.
Rural New Zealand, 2006. Over one transformative summer, 14 year-old Sid Bookman discovers desire, identity and the internet, as she imitates the people she longs to be loved by.
A rookie in the police force must engage in a cat-and-mouse game with a pistol-wielding psychopath who becomes obsessed with her.
A funeral director tells four strange tales of horror with an African American focus to three drug dealers he traps in his place of business.

After being dumped by her live-in boyfriend, unemployed dancer Paula McFadden and her ten-year-old daughter Lucy are forced to live with struggling off-Broadway actor Elliot Garfield, who is subletting their apartment.

Eight years after the disappearance of Cassandra, some disturbing incidents seem to indicate that she's still alive. Police, parents and Cassandra herself, will try to unravel the mystery of her disappearance.

Four close friends are renowned filmmakers in Yugoslavia in the 1950s, but their sexual orientation raises suspicion. A communist party loyalist is sent to sabotage their lives, turning their pursuit of freedom into a battle for survival.

movies.primaryTitle: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
movies.originalTitle: Tales from the Darkside: The Movie
movies.plot: To stall a witch plotting to eat him, a boy reads her horror tales dealing with a collegian's resurrection of a mummy, a murderous cat, and an artist's pact with a gargoyle.

movies.primaryTitle: Do Not Expect Too Much from the End of the World
movies.originalTitle: Nu astepta prea mult de la sfârsitul lumii
movies.plot: An overworked and underpaid production assistant drives around Bucharest to shoot the casting for a workplace safety video commissioned by a multinational company.

When an escort girl is found dead in the offices of a Japanese company in Los Angeles, detectives Web Smith and John Connor act as liaison between the company's executives and the investigating cop Tom Graham.

Bosnia and Herzegovina during 1993 at the time of the heaviest fighting between the two warring sides. Two soldiers from opposing sides in the conflict, Nino and Ciki, become trapped in no man's land, whilst a third soldier becomes a living booby trap.
A farm boy recruits a band of outlaws to save the planet Akir from dark forces that threaten to wipe them out from the face of the universe. A battle stretching beyond the stars begins here.
An Irish-American street punk tries to make it big in the world of organized crime.
A sister and brother face the realities of familial responsibility as they begin to care for their ailing father.
Elena and Jake meet by chance on New Years Eve, arguing for the same taxi. However, instead of going their separate ways after sharing a taxi, they initiate a determined relationship.
Victims of violent crime and perpetrators meet up in a restorative justice group in order to have a dialogue and heal from their trauma.
When a border dispute arises between the U.S. and Canada, the Super Troopers are tasked with establishing a Highway Patrol station in the disputed area.
Marie is a vampire with a thirst for bad guys. When she fails to properly dispose of one of her victims, a violent mob boss, she bites off more than she can chew and faces a new, immortal danger.
An adventurous girl, a young blind hermit, and a goofy two-headed dragon race to find the lost sword Excalibur to save King Arthur and Camelot from disaster.
A devout Catholic man's rigid principles are challenged during a one-night stay with Maud, a divorced woman with an outsize personality.

The hit musical based on the life of Eva Perón (Evita Duarte), a B-picture Argentinian actress who eventually became the wife of Argentinian president Juan Domingo Perón, and the most beloved and hated woman in Argentina.
High-powered attorney Marley faces her most personal case yet when she is tasked with uncovering the truth behind the shooting of her best friend Fela's husband.
Aida is a translator for the UN in the small town of Srebrenica. When the Serbian army takes over the town, her family is among the thousands of citizens looking for shelter in the UN camp.
A photojournalist's obsessive quest for the truth about the first expedition to Mt. Everest leads him to search for an esteemed climber who went missing.
The wives of New York gangsters in Hell's Kitchen in the 1970s continue to operate their husbands' rackets after they're locked up in prison.
Two mysterious orphan children have extraordinary powers and are chased by a scheming millionaire. But where do these kids really call home?

A young governess is hired to look after an orphaned girl, but the return of the girl's problematic brother uncovers secrets from their past. A modern take on Henry James' novella "The Turn of the Screw."
Follows a couple whose emotional states have supernatural effects on their surroundings, forcing them to evaluate whether their relationship is beneficial or harmful.
Survivors from a massive earthquake struggle for a new life in Seoul.
A lonely custodian discovers purpose and community when he enters the world of competitive drift racing.
When a young orphaned boy living on the streets of Shibuya stumbles upon a fantastic world of beasts, he's taken in by a gruff warrior beast looking for an apprentice.
A spoiled brat who falls overboard from a steamship in the 1920s gets picked up by a New England fishing boat, where he's made to earn his keep by joining the crew in their work.
A government researcher, sent to research the "menace" of wolves in the north, learns about the true beneficial and positive nature of the species.
A woman washes ashore a small uninhabited island after an accident. The situation turns from bad to worse when she realizes there is a mysterious creature hunting at night.
A powerful journey through India's most challenging historical period reveals the universal struggle for human dignity and the fundamental right to exist.
On Coney Island in the 1950s, a lifeguard tells the story of a middle-aged carousel operator, his beleaguered wife and the visitor who turns their lives upside-down.
In 1912 London, a young working mother is galvanized into radical political activism supporting the right for women to vote, and is willing to meet violence with violence to achieve this end.

movies.primaryTitle: Untitled Romantic Thriller Keanu Reeves/Sandra Bullock Amazon MGM Studios Project
movies.originalTitle: Untitled Romantic Thriller Keanu Reeves/Sandra Bullock Amazon MGM Studios Project

movies.plot: An unimpressive, everyday man is forced into a situation where he is told to kill a politician to save his kidnapped daughter.
Émilie meets Camille, who is attracted to Nora, who crosses paths with Amber. Three girls and a boy - they're friends, sometimes lovers, and often both.
The guests at an upper-class dinner party find themselves unable to leave.
About a courageous factory worker who fights for justice when cheated and mistreated by her company. Based on the life of Lilly Ledbetter.
Fed up with being single on holidays, two strangers agree to be each other's platonic plus-ones all year long, only to catch real feelings along the way.
American-born Gogol, the son of Indian immigrants, wants to fit in among his fellow New Yorkers, despite his family's unwillingness to let go of their traditional ways.
Married couple in 1980s LA leaves luxury life for nightly adventures with enigmatic Nameless and hedonistic group, entering surreal world of excess and violence.
After inventing a drug that induces time-compressed virtual realities, young Ren grapples with partner Sam over how to use their powerful creation.
After escaping from an insane asylum, the bonkers Charles Dreyfus sends 26 assassins on the trail of the forever bumbling Inspector Clouseau.
Four socially troubled 18-year-olds from the south of England go on holiday to Malia.

movies.primaryTitle: Bardo: False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths
movies.originalTitle: Bardo, falsa crónica de unas cuantas verdades
movies.plot: An acclaimed documentarian goes on an introspective journey through surreal dreamscapes to reconcile with the past, the present and his Mexican identity.
A troupe of hilariously self-obsessed theater stars swarm into a small conservative Indiana town in support of a high-school girl who wants to take her girlfriend to the prom.
Follows a hustler and his rise to the top of the corruption that surrounded the real estate bubble after the arrival of the euro in Spain.
When her boyfriend dumps her before their exotic vacation, a young woman persuades her ultra-cautious mother to travel with her to paradise, with unexpected results.
Satirical interpretations of world events and curious human behavior.
A former Christian missionary, who specializes in debunking religious phenomena, investigates a small town which seems to be suffering from the 10 biblical plagues.

A disgraced, alcoholic detective on the skids (Nicole Kidman) gets a signal from a crime-boss she put away that he's out and coming for her. Damaged as she is, she goes in hard for one last ditch do-or-die shot at redemption -and revenge.
An aspiring film maker turns to porn after little success, then falls into a pursuit of crime with his band of misfits and suffers the repercussions of their unprecedented journey.
A social worker tries to get a pimp to change his ways.
When a U.S. Naval captain shows signs of mental instability that jeopardises the ship, the first officer is urged to consider relieving him of command.
While investigating a car theft ring, Axel Foley comes across a much bigger crime; the same men who killed his boss are running a counterfeit money ring out of a theme park in Los Angeles.
A young black pianist becomes embroiled in the lives of an upper-class white family set among the racial tensions, infidelity, violence and other nostalgic events in early 1900s New York City.
A man's life is derailed when an ominous pattern of events repeats itself in exactly the same manner every day, ending at precisely 2:22 p.m.
A man looks back over his life as he grapples with a painful secret he has kept hidden for 20 years, one that threatens to derail the life he has built for himself and his soon to be husband.
A vampire family deals with their father's death in NYC while being pursued by Van Helsing and his nephew. Love and destruction clash in this modern vampire story.
Following a catastrophic event that has destroyed civilization, a young man must confront a group of cannibals who have murdered his father and stolen the medicine keeping his girlfriend alive.

Papa Zola, a schoolteacher, and his gifted daughter Pipi go on small adventures that often escalate. Their escapades showcase their loving relationship and Pipi's intelligence, as they navigate whimsical situations together.
In Depression-era North Carolina, the future of George Pemberton's timber empire becomes complicated when he marries Serena.
A young writer checks into a Minnesota rehabilitation center for drug addiction.
A young woman conceals the fact of her terminal cancer to live her life with a passion she never had before.
A soon-to-be bride on her way to a wedding rehearsal is having second thoughts and decides to take a detour. Car breaks down and a hitchiker offers help. Could it be fate?
Sadistic members of a villainous family return to their childhood home to terrorize the new homeowners and their guests.
A t-virus outbreak in San Francisco leads to Alcatraz Island, where a new evil has taken residence.
Acclaimed writer and historian Deborah E. Lipstadt must battle for historical truth to prove the Holocaust actually occurred when David Irving, a renowned denier, sues her for libel.

Amidst a catastrophic hurricane, a coastal town battles nature's wrath and an onslaught of sharks. Braving torrential rain, debris, and darkness, they unite to survive the deadly predators and make it through the storm.
A naive young Mormon is recruited to act in porn movies.

movies.primaryTitle: The Human Condition II: Road to Eternity
movies.plot: As a conscript in war-time Japan's military, a pacifist struggles to maintain his determination to keep his ideals.
A former Marine and his old war buddy face off against the Mexican cartel behind the disappearance of his daughter.
A chemist (Garcia) loses his job to outsourcing. Two years later and still jobless, he hits on a solution: to genuinely eliminate his competition.
A feature film adaptation of the self-help book, 'The Secret', which focuses on the power of positive thinking.

movies.primaryTitle: SAS: Rise of the Black Swan
movies.plot: A small army of well trained criminals led by Grace Lewis have hijacked a train deep beneath the English Channel.
Hollywood director John L. Sullivan sets out to experience life as a homeless person in order to gain relevant life experience for his next movie.
A drifter obsessed with the supernatural stumbles upon an inn from which a series of strange events lead him to a manor where a severely ill adolescent girl is slowly becoming a vampire.
An estranged family gathers together in New York City for an event celebrating the artistic work of their father.

movies.primaryTitle: The Witcher: Nightmare of the Wolf
movies.originalTitle: The Witcher: Nightmare of the Wolf
movies.plot: Escaping from poverty to become a witcher, Vesemir slays monsters for coin and glory, but when a new menace rises, he must face the demons of his past.
Romantic drama about an aging playboy who falls for a sweet, but terminally ill, young woman.
Two unlikely prospector partners share the same wife in a California gold rush mining town.
A village official attending a wedding becomes entangled in an escalating family dispute over power and old resentments, testing his leadership as he tries to contain the situation.
Spike Lee's vibrant semi-autobiographical portrait of a school teacher, her stubborn jazz musician husband and their five kids living in Brooklyn in 1973.

movies.primaryTitle: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
movies.originalTitle: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
movies.plot: A missing heir of respected Scottish family, raised in African jungles by animals, finally returns to his estate only to realize that difference between the two worlds is really significant.
Lindsay is stuck in the middle of her relationship with Ben and his passion for the Boston Red Sox.
The emotional journey of Arun, his carefree bachelor days in engineering college, and how he matures through various phases of life.

movies.primaryTitle: The Lair of the White Worm
movies.originalTitle: The Lair of the White Worm
movies.plot: When an archaeologist uncovers a strange skull in a foreign land, the residents of a nearby town begin to disappear, leading to further inexplicable occurrences.
Rookie cop Denny Colt returns from the beyond as The Spirit, a hero whose mission is to fight against the bad forces in Central City.
A wealthy woman is murdered in her beach house. The husband is allegedly knocked out first. He inherits all. He has a female ex criminal prosecutor represent him in court.
Sita, a single mother, and her daughter, Gendis, experience mystical terror after their bus breaks down on the Alas Roban route.
A struggling painter's possessed by dark forces after he and his young family move into their dream home in rural Texas, in this creepy haunted-house tale.

Aware that the future does not hold many options for her in a riverside community on Marajó Island, a 13-year-old girl decides to confront the violent machinery that governs her family and the women in her community.
A former serial killer with Alzheimer's fights to protect his daughter from her psychotic boyfriend.
Jin Kazama witnesses the death of his mother Jun by Tekken in the slums known as Anvil. After finding a Tekken ID he decides to seek out vengeance for his mother's death.
Having recently been uprooted to Milan, Rocco and his four brothers each look for a new way in life when a prostitute comes between Rocco and his brother Simone.
A family finds themselves terrorized by their eight-year-old son's imaginary friend.

Follows Anne, a brilliant lawyer who lives with her husband Pierre and their daughters. Anne gradually engages in a passionate relationship with Theo, Pierre's son from a previous marriage, putting her career and family life in danger.
A boy tries to stop aliens who have taken over his town and are attempting to brainwash its inhabitants.
A determined villager challenges the aviation industry's elite by pursuing his vision of affordable air travel for all, despite numerous obstacles and setbacks
A young hot shot driver is in the middle of a championship season and is coming apart at the seams. A former CART champion is called in to give him guidance.

Molly owns a quaint little sweet shop. Joel works for a gigantic candy company threatening to shut her down. How they meet, fall in love, break up and get back together is hilariously recounted in this rom-com spoof.
After death, people have a week to choose only one memory to keep for eternity.
After fierce Roman commander Marcus Vinicius becomes infatuated with beautiful Christian hostage Lygia, he begins to question the tyrannical leadership of the despotic emperor Nero.

movies.primaryTitle: Maquia: When the Promised Flower Blooms
movies.originalTitle: Sayonara no asa ni yakusoku no hana o kazarô
movies.plot: Maquia, a teenager, belongs to the Iorph community whose members can live for hundreds of years. But her life changes when the Iorph settlement is invaded and she comes across an orphan.
A political activist is convinced that her guest is a man who once tortured her for the government.
A group of friends who venture into the remote Texas woods for a party weekend find themselves stalked by Bigfoot.
A remake of the 1992 film about a pair of basketball hustlers who team up to earn extra cash.
Socially anxious hitman Melvin Smiley, an expert in his lucrative field, goes on a job and falls in love with his kidnapping victim, turning his world upside down.
Mitch and Sam must find $50,000--fast. The only problem: neither can keep a job. Mitch finds a way to make money by exploiting their only talents by opening a "Revenge for Hire" business.
A young woman befriends a lonely widow who's harboring a dark and deadly agenda toward her.

After treating a Monmouth rebel against King James II in 1680s England, a young Irish doctor is exiled as a slave to Jamaica where he captures a Spanish galleon and becomes the most feared pirate of the Caribbean.
A man forms an unexpected bond with a transient woman living in her van that's parked in his driveway.
A teen decides to go for a night on the town with his friends despite flunking his driver's test.
A British family struggles to survive the first months of World War II.

In the midst of a civil war, former violinists Jan and Eva Rosenberg, who have a tempestuous marriage, run a farm on a rural island. In spite of their best efforts to escape their homeland, the war impinges on every aspect of their lives.

From the haunted halls of the abbey in the past, a murderous rampage on Halloween in the present, to a monstrous apocalypse in the future; the seventeenth installment brings three tales of terror through every cycle.
A Kashmiri woman agrees to marry a Pakistani army officer in order to spy on Pakistan during the Indo-Pakistan War of 1971.
Experienced Green Beret sergeant Johnny Gallagher is escorting a prisoner, Airborne Ranger Thomas Boyette, back to the US, but Boyette escapes and Gallagher must risk life and limb to catch him.

On a trip to her hometown, workaholic Ally reminisces with her ex Sean and starts to question everything about the person she's become. Things only get more confusing when she meets Cassidy, who reminds her of the person she used to be.
Detective Ma Seok-do joins the Cyber Investigation Team to nab Baek Chang-ki, a former mercenary and the head of an online gambling organization.
A disturbed, delusional high-school student with aspirations of a career in medicine goes to extremes to earn the approval of her controlling mother.
Forced underground by the next ice age, a struggling outpost of survivors must fight to preserve humanity against a threat even more savage than nature.
A poet and photographer in Chicago explore their growing relationship while discussing love with friends. When she tests his feelings, romantic complications follow.
A dramatization of the Irish civil rights protest march and subsequent massacre by British troops on January 30, 1972.

movies.primaryTitle: Untitled Amazon MGM Studios/Navy Seal Mike Thornton Project
movies.originalTitle: Untitled Amazon MGM Studios/Navy Seal Mike Thornton Project
movies.plot: Follows Navy SEAL Mike Thornton during final days of Vietnam War, leading a desperate last stand with five men trapped behind enemy lines, fighting 150 soldiers before retreating to South China Sea, earning Congressional Medal of Honor.
A police officer faces a personal meltdown following a divorce and the death of his mother.
To impress his new girlfriend, a man agrees to look after her friend's kids, only to find that they are uncontrollably rambunctious.
The U.S. government decides to go after an agro-business giant with a price-fixing accusation, based on the evidence submitted by their star witness, vice president-turned-informant Mark Whitacre.
A famous author goes on a cruise trip with her friends and nephew in an effort to find fun and happiness while she comes to terms with her troubled past.
Witness a hellish vision of 1999, as social isolation, analog technology and disturbing home videos fuse into a nightmare of found footage savagery.

A crash landing leaves Kitai Raige and his father Cypher stranded on Earth, a millennium after events forced humanity's escape. With Cypher injured, Kitai must embark on a perilous journey to signal for help.

A British publisher is sent a manuscript detailing Soviet Union nuclear missile capabilities. British Intelligence intercept it and recruit him to investigate the author's editor, a beautiful Russian woman he claims never to have met.
A quirky Sri Lankan family seeking a fresh start in India transforms a disconnected neighborhood into a vibrant community with their infectious love and kindness.

movies.primaryTitle: The Good, the Bad, the Weird
movies.originalTitle: Joeun nom, napun nom, esanghan nom
movies.plot: The story of two outlaws and a bounty hunter in 1940s Manchuria and their rivalry to possess a treasure map while being pursued by the Japanese army and Chinese bandits.
A cafe owner discovers that the TV in his cafe suddenly shows images from the future, but only two minutes into the future.
A ventriloquist is at the mercy of his vicious dummy while he tries to renew a romance with his high school sweetheart.
Artemis Fowl, a young criminal prodigy, hunts down a secret society of fairies to find his missing father.

Yeong-soo, a widower, informs his son Jang-ho, an aspiring chef, of his plans to remarry Olga, a Russian woman. Jang-ho meets the unexpectedly young Olga and, during Yeong-soo's business trip to Russia, develops an unusual bond with her.
She's the perfect all-American parent: a great cook and homemaker, a devoted recycler, and a woman who'll literally kill to keep her children happy.

An engineer named Behzad travels to a rural village in Iran to witness a ritual associated with a woman's death. Meanwhile, the film follows his efforts to fit in with the local community and how he spends his time waiting for the event.
Military cadets take extreme measures to ensure the future of their academy when its existence is threatened by local condo developers.
The story of Nick Leeson, an ambitious investment broker who singlehandedly bankrupted one of the oldest and most important banks in Britain.

During the Cold War era, a German rock band relationship with an imprisoned friend named Andrej, inspired an iconic song, which became a symbol of hope, peace, and unity during the fall of the Berlin Wall.
A man and his son encounter an assassin in the forest.
A Tennessee farmer and marksman is drafted in World War I, and struggles with his pacifist inclinations before becoming one of the most celebrated war heroes.

Newly married Karthik and Anu buys an old apartment and starts their life, soon they start witnessing strange things happening in the house and and they think it is an act of ghost, but soon they find the shocking truth.
Misato and her anti-NERV group WILLE arrive in Paris, a city now red from core-ization. Crew from the flagship Wunder land on a containment tower.
A sketch artist and a cop work together to unravel the identity of an elusive killer using the descriptions of his face, etched into the memory of an eye-witness to the brutal crime.
During the Napoleonic wars, a British Navy Captain has adventures in Central American waters.

Krishna Mehra is an operative at Indian spy agency known as R&AW. She is assigned to track down the mole selling India's defense secrets, while all along grappling with her dual identity as a spy and a lover.
Laurie Strode, now the dean of a Northern California private school with an assumed name, must battle the Shape one last time, as the life of her own son hangs in the balance.

movies.primaryTitle: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
movies.originalTitle: Girls Just Want to Have Fun
movies.plot: Janey is new in town and soon meets Lynne, who shares her passion for dancing in general and "Dance TV" in particular.

A once-respected surgeon professor Rafal Wilczur who's lost his family and his memory gets a chance at redemption when he reconnects with someone from his forgotten past who can help him find the answers he needs.

The disappearance of his wife leaves Fernando, a quiet geography teacher, completely devastated. Aimless, he impersonates another man as a gardener at a Portuguese country house, where he forms an unexpected friendship with the owner.
A look at the top-secret, high-tech espionage war going on between cats and dogs, of which their human owners are blissfully unaware.

After 37 years, the canals of Amsterdam are once again blood red. Tara Lee is a young, ambitious detective of the Amsterdam police who is confronted with a number of gruesome incidents around the canals. She calls in the help of the retired Visser, who once arrested a serial killer who made the canals unsafe. They are faced with an opponent who seems to possess superhuman powers.
Karl Marx dreams of owning a farm while living a routine life with his vocal wife and kids. When his chance finally arrives, pressure and chaos send him on a desperate rush to transform his future.
A group of 30-year-olds who have been friends since high school attempt to throw an end-of-summer orgy.
A teen comes into possession of a new laptop and soon discovers that the previous owner is not only watching him but will also do anything to get it back.
A journalist takes on an underworld of crime and changes television forever.

A new wife Rita, who finds herself alone when husband Ariel works abroad. They both find sexual satisfaction in other people. When Ariel comes back, they both act like nothing happened. But will this keep their marriage from falling apart?

Alice works for "Rebelle" magazine, where she needs to let her hair down to get a promotion. When Balthazar returns a lost USB to Alice, the appearance of dating someone half her age helps her. Does it get real?

Political commentator Matt Walsh explores the changing concepts of sex and gender in the digital age, particularly the transgender rights movement, anti-transgender bigotry, and what it means to be a woman.
The fortunes of a husband and wife differ drastically after they divorce.
Conversations with death row inmate Michael Perry and those affected by his crime serve as an examination of why people - and the state - kill.
As two couples are visiting Niagara Falls, tensions between one wife and her husband reach the level of murder.
After losing his wife and his memory in a car accident, a single father undergoes an agonizing experimental treatment that causes him to question who he really is.

In the 1960s, a group of friends at an all-girls' school learn that their school is going to be combined with a nearby all-boys' school. They concoct a plan to save their school while dealing with their everyday problems.
When three young women are implicated in a crime, a retired lawyer steps forward to help them clear their names.
A woman is unexpectedly forced to choose between the husband she has long thought dead and the fiance who has finally brought her back to life.

During the Alaska gold rush, prospector George sends partner Sam to Seattle to bring his fiancée but when it turns out that she married another man, Sam returns with a pretty substitute, the hostess of the Henhouse dance hall.
C.S. Lewis, a world-renowned Christian theologian, writer and professor, leads a passionless life until he meets spirited poet Joy Gresham from the U.S.

movies.primaryTitle: How to Blow Up a Pipeline
movies.originalTitle: How to Blow Up a Pipeline
movies.plot: A crew of environmental activists plot a daring plan to disrupt an oil pipeline.
The Man in the Yellow Hat is an oddball museum employee who looks after his pet monkey, an inquisitive and wonderful creature whose enthusiasm often gets the best of him.
Vuk, a 30-year-old returnee from prison, who was driven by the suicide of his best friend, takes the responsibility for getting his younger brother on a safe and right path.
When night falls, and the players have their eyes closed, werewolves make victims among the villagers.
Pasolini's artistic and always vividly cinematic retelling of eight of Chaucer's famous tales.
Wong Fei-Hung is a mischievous, yet righteous young man, but after a series of incidents, his frustrated father has him disciplined by a master of drunken martial arts.
The only daughter of the Chinese emperor Han Xuandi escapes from a strict prince and seeks help from the Gauls and the two brave warriors Asterix and Obelix.
An ominous darkness invades a seemingly serene sunflower farm in North Dakota, and the Solomon family is torn apart by suspicion, mayhem and murder.
A Martian lands on Earth and makes friends with a reporter.

movies.primaryTitle: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Long Haul
movies.originalTitle: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: The Long Haul
movies.plot: A Heffley family road trip to attend Meemaw's 90th birthday party goes hilariously off course thanks to Greg's newest scheme to get to a video gaming convention.
A drama centered on two fighters in the Holger Danske World War II resistance group.
Plot unknown.
A video store clerk agrees to have his life filmed by a camera crew for a television show.
An emotionally-stunted aunt tries to bond with her 13-year-old niece, who wants nothing more than to run away and become a Juggalo.
On a long-distance train trip, a man finds romance--but also finds himself in danger of being killed, or at least pushed off the train.
A gripping tale of an investigation and a family which is threatened by it. Will Vijay Salgaonkar be able to protect his family this time?
Alex, a boy obsessed with scary stories, is imprisoned by an evil young witch in her contemporary New York City apartment.
A teenage girl and her father discover alien clones are replacing humans on a remote U.S. military base in Alabama.
A gang of young thieves flee Paris during the violent aftermath of a political election, only to hole up at an Inn run by neo-Nazis.

A couple in a troubled marriage locate a meteorite, initiating an encounter with a mysterious creature. Their lives are turned upside down by the discovery of the creature, which is a source of both pleasure and destruction.

Early 1700: Cartographer Jonathan Green (Jason Flemyng) from Forbidden Empire (2014) is back to map the Russian Far East. He's forced on to China, where he confronts the Dragon Master et al. The iron masked Russian Czar escapes the Tower of London to a Russian ship.
During a weekend backpacking trip in the Catskills, 17-year-old Sam navigates the clash of egos between her father and his oldest friend.
A gay Chinese-American and her traditionalist mother are reluctant to go public with secret loves that clash against cultural expectations.
An adventure between a father and his son, in a world where some humans have started mutating into other animal species.

Terri Fletcher is a small town girl with the voice of a big-time singer. When personal tragedy interrupts her steady life, Terri defies her father's wishes and secretly heads off to spend a summer at a Los Angeles performing arts academy.
An egotistical saxophonist and a young lounge singer meet on VJ Day and embark upon a strained and rocky romance, even as their careers begin a long, uphill climb.

movies.primaryTitle: To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You
movies.originalTitle: To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You
movies.plot: Lara Jean and Peter have just taken their relationship from pretend to officially official when another recipient of one of her old love letters enters the picture.

movies.primaryTitle: Put Your Soul on Your Hand and Walk
movies.originalTitle: Put Your Soul on Your Hand and Walk
movies.plot: A filmmaker connects with a Palestinian woman in Gaza who documents life under bombardment. Their 200+ days of digital exchanges, the meaning shifts after Fatem's death in an Israeli attack on 16/ April 2025.

A famous lifestyle writer must maintain her carefully crafted image when TV cameras arrive for Christmas dinner. Her plan to have her best friend pose as her spouse leads to unexpected feelings and revelations.
A tough criminal is arrested after hiding the loot from a Paris armored truck robbery. A talkative dimwit befriends him in prison and escapes with him - chased by police and his evil crime boss.
The night before his big medical school interview, a promising student celebrates his 21st birthday with his two best friends.
The classic gangster story of Bugsy Malone told with an all-child cast.

In the quiet hill town of Ranni, humble taxi driver Shanmughan treasures one thing above all - his aging Ambassador car. When fate puts him to the test, he must prove just how far he'll go for what he holds dear.
As a mother and daughter struggle to cope with the terrors of the post-revolution, war-torn Tehran of the 1980s, a mysterious evil begins to haunt their home.

A gang of orphans travels to the south in quest of a new life after a viral outbreak decimates the adult population of the nation, only to find themselves at the mercy of a psychotic woman who is hiding a perilous secret.

movies.primaryTitle: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Beginning of a New Era
movies.originalTitle: Uma Musume: Pretty Derby - Beginning of a New Era
movies.plot: Uma Musume - they were born to run. Born with names from other worlds, sometimes with strange, sometimes with glorious histories, they inherit the souls of these names and run. Aiming only at the goal beyond our eyes.
The fictionalized life of singer Loretta Lynn, a girl who rose from humble beginnings to become a country music star in the 1960s/70s.
A kidnapped woman faces down hitmen sent by a mob boss/her captor while trying to protect her family from his wrath.

movies.primaryTitle: How to Draw a Perfect Circle
movies.plot: Guilherme and Sofia, brother and sister, grow up sharing experiences and slowly discovering their sexuality. The thing that Sofia doesn't know is how far Guilherme will go to keep her inside his own perverse, dark and perfect circle.

An operative for an elite private intelligence firm finds her priorities changing dramatically after she is tasked with infiltrating an anarchist group known for executing covert attacks upon major corporations.
Sanal departs Cochin Airport in the rain, journeying through Idukki's landscapes to meet Leena and fulfill their dream, while their hearts weave through shared memories of joy and sorrow.
Margaret's life is in order. She is capable, disciplined and successful. Everything is under control until David returns - that is - carrying with him the horrors of Margaret's past.
Younger generation vs. "older" folks on vacation at an Italian villa.
An adaptation of the classic Dickens tale, where an orphan meets a pickpocket on the streets of London. From there, he joins a household of boys who are trained to steal for their master.
A powerful London theater critic becomes entangled in a web of deceit and murder.
"Merrily We Roll Along" follows Franklin Shepard, a talented Broadway composer who abandons his theater career in New York and all his friends in order to produce movies in Los Angeles.
A spoof of low budget 1950s science-fiction movies, interspersed with various comedy sketches and fake commercials making fun of late-night television.
5 young Norwegians head up to the mountains to snowboard. One breaks his leg and it's getting dark soon, so they spend the night in a big, abandoned hotel, closed 30 years ago. They are not alone.
A satirical drama exploring the life of a troubled son within a powerful American dynasty.

movies.primaryTitle: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
movies.originalTitle: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
movies.plot: The people of a small village in Victorian India stake their future on a game of cricket against their ruthless British rulers.
In czarist Russia, a neurotic soldier and his distant cousin formulate a plot to assassinate Napoleon.

The timely story of a normal family disintegrating under financial pressure, eventually driven to the unimaginable. We witness the terrifying events unfold through daughter Judith's video camera, which subsequently becomes Exhibit A.
A young woman inherits an old hotel in Louisiana where, following a series of supernatural "accidents", she learns that the building was built over one of the entrances to Hell.
Jack Cates once again enlists the aid of ex-con Reggie Hammond - this time to take down The Iceman, a ruthless drug lord operating in the San Francisco bay area.

A struggling female soprano in 1934 Paris finally finds work after posing as a female impersonator, but it complicates her personal life when a visiting Chicago gangster finds himself inexplicably attracted to the seemingly male performer.

movies.primaryTitle: The Man Who Killed Hitler and Then the Bigfoot
movies.originalTitle: The Man Who Killed Hitler and Then the Bigfoot
movies.plot: A legendary American war veteran is recruited to hunt a mythical creature.
Set during a vicious storm, two criminal brothers on the run seek refuge in a desolate farmhouse. Taking the resident family captive, they find the house holds dark secrets of its own.
When a young boy mails his Christmas wish list to Santa with one crucial spelling error, a devilish Jack Black arrives to wreak havoc on the holidays.
A day in the life of a South Side Chicago barbershop.
A gang of ex-cons rob a casino during Elvis convention week.

A soon to be divorced Beverly Hills socialite is determined to prove to her husband and herself that she can finish what she starts out to do, by becoming a den mother to a troop of Beverly Hills Girl Scouts.
A father driven into desire, a son coveting that of his father's and the sorrowful maternity that hovers them into tragedy.
A troubled and racist African-American L.A.P.D. Officer will stop at nothing to force out a friendly interracial couple who just moved in next door to him.
Explores Leni Riefenstahl's artistic legacy and her complex ties to the Nazi regime, juxtaposing her self-portrayal with evidence suggesting awareness of the regime's atrocities.
In Japan for the funeral of his long-lost love, a tough French detective learns that he also has a teenage daughter and that her life is in danger from the Yakuza.
A group of juvenile delinquents live a violent and crime-filled life in the festering slums of Mexico City, as the morals of young Pedro are gradually corrupted and destroyed by the others.
On Christmas Eve, three lifelong friends spend the night in New York City looking for the Holy Grail of Christmas parties.
Set against the backdrop of the opioid epidemic, stories of an undercover cop, a professor and a grieving mother collide.
Sam Childers is a former drug-dealing biker tough guy who found God and became a crusader for hundreds of Sudanese children who've been forced to become soldiers.

movies.primaryTitle: Josee, the Tiger and the Fish
movies.plot: After befriending a marine biology student, a sarcastic artist living with paraplegia begins to experience the world beyond her home.
A 3D-animated movie set in Paris in the year 1910 and centered on a monster who lives in a garden and his love for a beautiful, young singer.

Ronnie runs a Disco walking tour with his son, Brayden. When a sexy woman takes the tour, it begins a competition between father and son for her love. It also signals the arrival of an oily strangler who stalks the streets at night.
A poignant story of forbidden love and the loss of innocence set in England prior to World War II.
Two boys defend Treasure Town and Yakuza try to take over and clear it for new development.

Ryota is a successful workaholic businessman. When he learns that his biological son was switched with another boy after birth, he faces the difficult decision to choose his true son or the boy he and his wife have raised as their own.
A passionate defense attorney fights against prejudice and corruption in the justice system while representing a teenage client wrongly presumed guilty of a serious crime.
A beautiful woman helps an inept scam artist get his game together.
An alien consciousness, sent to Earth to spy on one of its own kind, learns what it means to be human.
In Washington, D.C., a reporter faces a possible jail sentence for outing a CIA agent and refusing to reveal her source.

Following Jigsaw's grisly demise, Mark Hoffman is commended as a hero, but Agent Strahm is suspicious, and delves into Hoffman's past. Meanwhile, another group of people are put through a series of gruesome tests.
A stone-broke gay actor and a privileged bonehead with a failing business cross paths on a winter night and join forces in a quest around London to find a meaning to their miserable lives.

John Preston is a British Agent with the task of preventing the Russians detonating a nuclear explosion next to an American base in the UK. The Russians are hoping this will shatter the "special relationship" between the two countries.
Explores the spiritual pain of bullfighting, the tormented torero in a ring, one of the most excessive and graphic examples of the origin of Southern European civilization
A young Comanche warrior tests her hunting skills against deadly menace. Her mission turns into a fight for survival against never-before-seen opponents, both human and extraterrestrial.
Two French cops, investigating separate murders, find a common link between the killings. As more murders occur, the two find an increasing number of horrific details pointing to a conspiracy.
Joey Boca (Kevin Kline) owns a pizza parlor, and is married to Rosalie (Tracey Ullman). He's also a serial womanizer. Rosalie goes to extremes when she finds he has been cheating.
The fate of a Hungarian Jewish family throughout the 20th century.
While dealing with a friend's cold feet on his wedding day, a writer reminisces about his youth with his best friends.
A film about the battle between love and fear, between two stubborn men and their opposing beliefs and the outcome of the love stories of 3 couples.

movies.primaryTitle: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
movies.originalTitle: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
movies.plot: A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams.
Follows the investigations following the 1993 serial Bombay bomb blasts, told through the different stories of the people involved --police, conspirators, victims, middlemen.

Former Special Forces operative, Jack Johnson, uses the Stand Your Ground law to seek vengeance for his wife's murder, igniting a brutal war against a local crime lord's family and ending in an explosive showdown.

Love takes a furry twist in this slice of romantic comedy when a young woman falls for a stray dog with a secret: by night, he becomes a man. Follow the journey of the golden retriever and the friend who gives him a home.
The dramatic collapse of a wealthy, industrialist/Junker family during the reign of the Third Reich.
The police are on the trail of a serial killer, but with the victims being fellow officers, will they be able to catch the killer and solve the case in time?
An immigrant housemaid seduces a 15-year-old boy and later fakes her own death as part of his chauffeur's blackmail plot. Troubles arise when the two start to fall in love.
A Chinese woman lives for herself in silence, celebrating the prosperous Belle Epoque with songs and dance.
Venomous spiders get exposed to a noxious chemical that causes them to grow to monumental proportions.

A skilled bodyguard is assigned to protect a reclusive movie star from a stalker and must pose as his girlfriend to keep the threat hidden. On his family ranch, the assignment blurs lines as proximity complicates the job.
A strange prehistoric beast lurks in the depths of the Amazonian jungle. A group of scientists try to capture the animal and bring it back to civilization for study.

A personal shopper in Paris refuses to leave the city until she makes contact with her twin brother who previously died there. Her life becomes more complicated when a mysterious person contacts her via text message.

Daniel experiences a spiritual transformation in a detention center. Although his criminal record prevents him from applying to the seminary, he has no intention of giving up his dream and decides to minister a small-town parish.
Children are hidden away up in an attic by their conspiring mother and grandmother.
At Pacific Palisades High, a poor Latino falls hard for a troubled girl from an affluent neighborhood.
A crew of rugged firefighters meet their match when attempting to rescue three rambunctious kids.
A group of teenage girlfriends deal with their impending graduation from high school.
An octogenarian woman transitions to life in assisted living as she contends with her conflicting relationship to herself and her caregivers amidst her shifting memory, age identity, and desires.
The true story of a man who became the Pentagon's most valuable spy during the last years of the Cold War.
The journey of an aspiring filmmaker as he bands together his group of friends to make a film for his town, Malegaon.
A woman asks her ex-lover for help in order to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.
When the Queen of the Hard Rock Trolls tries to take over all the Troll kingdoms, Queen Poppy and her friends try different ways to save all the Trolls.
Grown men's recreational baseball game stretches to extra innings on their beloved field's final day before demolition. Humor and nostalgia intertwine as daylight fades, signaling an era's end.

I Am Richard Pryor tells the story of the legendary performer and iconic social satirist, who transcended race and social barriers by delivering his honest irreverent and biting humor to America's stages and living rooms until his death at 65. Featuring an iconic comedic cast, historians, activists and artists who provide a unique brushstroke into the complex world of Pryor. The film dives deeply into the psyche of a comedic genius whose mother was a prostitute, father a pimp, and grandmother a madam. Pryor dispensed a penetrating comedic view of African American life - essentially comedy without jokes - that struck a chord with audiences of every ethnic, social and economic disposition.

An accountant is introduced to a mysterious sex club known as The List by his lawyer friend. But in this new world, he soon becomes the prime suspect in a woman's disappearance and a multi-million dollar heist.
Vincke and Verstuyft are the best detectives of the Antwerp police department. They are confronted with the murder on a leading executive and put all their effort to catch the murderer.
A drama based on the life of college football hero Ernie Davis, the first African-American to win the Heisman Trophy.

Historical fresco recounting the life and times of the Prophet Mohammed, the last of the Abrahamic religion, in the sense that, according to Islam, he completed and sealed the monotheistic revelation made to Abraham.
A killer threatens to expose the fatal secret binding a group of sorority sisters.
