Two slackers competing for the affections of an heiress inadvertently become her protectors from an evil criminal.
A businessman with a disfigured face obtains a lifelike mask from his doctor, but the mask starts altering his personality.
A hardened sergeant and the four core members of his infantry unit try to survive World War II as they move from battle to battle throughout Europe.
The young son of an American diplomat and his wife may be the spawn of Satan.
Biopic about notorious American serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer, taking place in both the past and the present.
A struggling artist living in Los Angeles meets a girl who may hold the key to his happiness.
During the French Revolution, a surprisingly diverse company shares a coach, trying to catch up something - the time itself, perhaps.
A wealthy pregnant woman living out an escapist fantasy falls in love with a younger woman starting her life over.
A couple try to save their marriage during a zombie apocalypse.
Backpackers Hanna and Liv take a job in a remote Australian pub for some extra cash and are confronted with a bunch of unruly locals and a situation that rapidly leaps out of their control.
Detective James Knight's last-minute assignment to the Independence Day shift turns into a race against time to stop an unbalanced EMT worker who's posing as a cop.
After surviving a heart-attack, a 59-year-old carpenter must fight bureaucratic forces to receive Employment and Support Allowance.

Jenny's parents and siblings are always trying to set her up with a man when she visits them. What they don't know is that she already met the right person 5 years ago--her "roommate" Kitty--and she wants to marry her and start a family.
A priest tries to stop a gangster from corrupting a group of street kids.
After 5 years in a coma, Madison Neubauer wakes to find her home and family in the grip of 'The Observance' - a religious cult who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets.
Revolves around the high and low points of Sam Manekshaw who became the first Indian Army officer to be promoted to the rank of Field Marshal.
In Alaska's winter darkness, a mother and son transform their house into a nightmare, drawing people in for abuse and cannibalism.
A daring team of seven embarks on the pursuit of being the first to traverse Greenland's unexplored ice sheet.
A director discovers a box of videotapes showing the creepy film project of two students that stars a local horror legend.
A foul-mouthed former gymnastics bronze medalist with local celebrity status reluctantly trains a rising Olympics aspirant.
To satisfy his nagging parents, a gay landlord and a female tenant agree to a marriage of convenience, but his parents arrive to visit and things get out of hand.
A med student is forced by his traveling salesman dad to cancel a top summer internship and look after his hot mom, who's bedridden with a broken leg. Applying lotion to her legs arouses him.
In the fourth outing for the vacation franchise, the Griswolds have to survive Vegas fever when they go to Las Vegas for a fun family vacation.
King Henry II of England comes to terms with his affection for his close friend and confidant Thomas Becket, who finds his true honor by observing God's divine will rather than the King's.

movies.primaryTitle: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex * But Were Afraid to Ask
movies.originalTitle: Everything You Always Wanted to Know About Sex * But Were Afraid to Ask
movies.plot: Seven stories are trying to answer the question: what is sex? Or maybe they are not trying.
The life of Cuban poet and novelist, Reinaldo Arenas.
Free climber Emily Harrington attempts a record-breaking climb of El Capitan in Yosemite.
When the body of his oldest friend is found buried in a shallow grave, Dan, a small-town cop, seeks answers from a volatile Hermit who may have been the last person to see his friend alive.
The rise and fall of a grass-roots rural politician who eventually becomes mired in the sort of political corruption he vehemently railed against on his way to the governor's mansion.
A romance between young Parisians, shown through a series of vignettes.
An orphan boy named Tim is afraid of the dark. However, when the stars start going out in the sky, he finds himself exploring the world of the night, alongside his new friend, the Cat Shepherd.
A petroleum exploration expedition comes to an isolated island and encounters a colossal giant gorilla.

movies.originalTitle: Hana rokushô ga akeru hi ni
movies.plot: Keitarô lives inside an abandoned factory once surrounded by lush forest, now redeveloped with solar panels. Before the factory's demolition, he aims to launch his late father's firework with his brother and friend, closing a chapter.

movies.primaryTitle: Robin Williams: Come Inside My Mind
movies.originalTitle: Robin Williams: Come Inside My Mind
movies.plot: An intimate look into the life and work of the revered master comedian and actor, Robin Williams.
An alcoholic marries a young woman and systematically addicts her to booze so that they can share his "passion" together.
Imagination and reality collide when young Nim's father goes missing at sea. Fate brings to her the author of the Alex Rover series, her favorite books, and together they try to find Nim's father.
After getting married and having a daughter, a retired legendary hitman must protect his family when his past catches up to him.
Misty, a gifted actress, struggles with vices hindering her career revival. Jordan, a director with a perfect role, presents a golden opportunity complicated by their turbulent history.
A mentally challenged young woman seeks independence by obtaining her own apartment and attending college while her family plans her sister's wedding.

A dim-witted teenager and his new coworker try to save the old burger joint they work for from failing after the opening of a brand new burger restaurant across the street, which is planning to put them out of business.

movies.primaryTitle: The Killing of a Chinese Bookie
movies.originalTitle: The Killing of a Chinese Bookie
movies.plot: A proud strip club owner is forced to come to terms with himself as a man when his gambling addiction gets him in hot water with the mob, who offer him only one alternative.
Four couples sail the thin line between desire and search for authenticity, in a world where truth is as fragile as their relationships.
An intimate look at the extraordinary rise, fall and redemption of televangelist Tammy Faye Bakker.

After mysteriously inheriting an abandoned coastal property, Ben and his family accidentally unleash an ancient, long-dormant creature that terrorized the entire region-including his own ancestors-for generations.

Mikey's night terrors become reality when his mother begins showing signs of demonic possession. What he's about to experience will haunt him for the rest of his life and claim countless lives across generations.
An Indian agent races against a doomsday clock as a ruthless mercenary, with a bitter vendetta, mounts an apocalyptic attack against the country.

The eponymous Celtic warrior who rules the Iceni people alongside her husband, Prasutagus. The King dies at the hands of Roman soldiers, leaving Boudica's kingdom without a male heir, and the Romans seize her land and property.

Michael Moore's view on what happened to the United States after 9/11 and how the Bush Administration allegedly used the tragic event to push forward its agenda for unjust wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.
After his family is kidnapped during their sailing trip in Spain, a young Wall Street trader is confronted by the people responsible: intelligence agents looking to recover a mysterious briefcase.
A comedy centered on an idealist who barges into the lives of his three sisters.

movies.originalTitle: Nakitai watashi wa neko o kaburu
movies.plot: Miyo Sasaki is in love with her classmate Kento Hinode and tries repeatedly to get Kento's attention by transforming into a cat, but at some point, the boundary between herself and the cat becomes ambiguous.
A caveman seeks revenge on a much larger competitor for the hand of a beautiful cavewoman.
Nat Turner, a literate slave and preacher in the antebellum South, orchestrates an uprising.

Two upper-class teenage girls in suburban Connecticut rekindle their unlikely friendship after years of growing apart. Together, they hatch a plan to solve both of their problems-no matter what the cost.
An ominous help note finds its way to a 1980s post office, connecting a dead letter investigator to a kidnapped keyboard technician.
A Las Vegas mob enforcer travels back to his hometown to investigate his brother's mysterious death.
Dominican baseball star Miguel "Sugar" Santos is recruited to play in the U.S. minor-leagues.
Set in 1944 Italy, the story of four black American soldiers who get trapped in a Tuscan village during WWII.

Freddy the gym teacher has to teach remedial English in summer (high) school, if he wants tenure. As he can only teach gym and his students want fun, emphasis is on "field trips" - until he's fired unless all his students pass the test.
A startling and courageous landmark documentary that unflinchingly confronted the United States' involvement in Vietnam at the height of the controversy that surrounded it.
A teenager accidentally activates a wristwatch that enables him to stop time.
When Dev finds out his wife is cheating on him, he secretly blackmails his wife and her lover as a form of revenge.
After an oil company plane crashes in the Sahara, the survivors' hopes are buoyed by one of the passengers, an airplane designer who comes up with a plan to build a flyable plane from the wreckage.
After a ruffian accidentally ruins his meal, a traveler retorts violently and demands an apology, unintentionally finding himself in a web of violence, crime and corruption spun by a feared criminal.
A love story centering on the connection between music and memory and how they transport us, sometimes literally.
A female assassin leaves a trail of bodies behind her as she seeks revenge.
An orphaned boy and his magical dragon come to the New England town of Passamaquoddy with his abusive adoptive parents in pursuit.
A coming-of-age psychological thriller that plays out the unsettling reality of a kid who holds his family captive in a hole in the ground.
A mother helps her daughter work through four crucial days of recovery from substance abuse.
It's 1987 and Danielle, the high-school 'Dirty Girl', is running away. With her is chubby, gay Clarke, a bag of flour called Joa and a Walkman full of glorious '80s tunes.
Sultan is a classic underdog tale about a wrestler's journey, looking for a comeback by defeating all odds.
A couple tries to repair their marriage while staying at a hotel in France.

movies.primaryTitle: Until the End of the World
movies.plot: Claire and Eugene's relationship is falling apart, while a nuclear satellite threatens to fall out of orbit and destroy Earth. Claire travels the world when she meets Sam, a man with connections to technology that could change everything.

An Ivy League drop-out travels to the Colorado wilderness, where he joins a team of buffalo hunters on a journey that puts his life and sanity at risk. Based on the highly acclaimed novel by John Williams.

movies.originalTitle: Il fiore delle mille e una notte
movies.plot: In ancient Arabia, a beautiful slave girl chooses a youth to be her new master, then she is kidnapped and they must search for each other. Stories are told within stories: love, travel and the whims of destiny.

After returning from a business trip in Finland, Bruno (Bruno Ganz) find that his wife Marianne (Edith Clever) wants her husband to leave her alone with their son. A struggle with loneliness and adapting to the new situation ensues.
Policewoman threatens to jail her ex's brother unless he agrees to go undercover and inform on a gang of hooligans.
They walked into a haunted house with a history of possession and murder. The victims never came out, but the footage did.
The personalities of two former baseball players clash as they traverse the rural back roads of a post-plague New England teeming with the undead.
Danish journalist Mads Brügger goes undercover as a Liberian Ambassador to embark on a dangerous yet hysterical journey to uncover the blood diamond trade in Africa.
A documentary on 85-year-old sushi master Jiro Ono, his renowned Tokyo restaurant, and his relationship with his son and eventual heir, Yoshikazu.
Four vignettes about the lives of the Cuban people set during the pre-revolutionary era.
Ryan Swan must carve his way through the Hawaiian crime world to wreak vengeance on the kingpin who murdered his father.

When a young woman meets an aspiring saxophonist in her father's record shop in 1950s Harlem, their love ignites a sweeping romance that transcends changing times, geography, and professional success.
A young genius frantically races against time to crack an enemy code and solve the mystery surrounding the woman he loves.
A group of very different individuals staying at a luxurious hotel in Berlin deal with each of their respective dramas.
An American soldier struggles with an ethical dilemma when he becomes involved with a widow of a fallen officer.

When slaughterhouse workers Endre and Mária discover they share the same dreams, where they meet in a forest as deer and fall in love, they decide to make their dreams come true, but it's difficult in real life.
A ruthlessly ambitious Scottish lord seizes the throne with the help of his scheming wife and a trio of witches.
Two detectives observe an escaped convict's ex-girlfriend, but complications set in when one of them falls for her.
A young woman moves from the French countryside to Paris and begins a passionate love affair with a feminist leader in this drama set in 1970s France.
To save their farm, the resident animals go bounty hunting for a notorious outlaw.
Uma is a young woman who wakes up in an apparently idyllic reform school for young ladies. But a dark secret lies within its walls.
A humorous take on Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's classic mysteries featuring Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson.
A guy makes a documentary of the rap band CB4 by following them. CB4 got popular by stealing Gusto's name, background and image. He wants them dead.
A troubled hitman seeks aid from a forger to help him get papers to China. However, the drug lord has hired replacements to finish the job, and kill the hitman.
The new kid in school must battle a gang of street toughs after stealing the gang leader's girl.
Follows a mysterious herd of ghost elephants in the jungles of Angola.
On her first holiday without her father, Zoey wants to create a magical Christmas for her family just like the ones Mitch used to do.
A young Honduran girl and a Mexican gangster are united in a journey across the U.S. border.
A psychiatrist must cure a young patient who presents himself as Don Juan, the world's greatest lover.
A comedic take on the daily life of car-wash employees, chronicling their hopes, fears, joys, dreams, and tribulations, and meeting some eccentric customers along the way.
The citizens of a small Texas town become worried and panicked when a local bad boy escapes prison and heads for his hometown.
When a southern Italian town is rocked by a string of child murders, the police and two urban outcasts search for the culprit amid scapegoating within the superstitious community.

A stand-up comedy writer navigates the complexities of living with his father while raising his autistic son with his former wife. He grapples with hurdles as he balances family responsibilities and his career.
A committed film director struggles to complete his movie while coping with a myriad of crises, personal and professional, among the cast and crew.
A witness to a mob assassination flees for her life, running from town to town and switching identities along the way, but she cannot seem to elude Milo, the chief hit man sent after her.

Fanatic is a government trooper who is heading an expedition to find an Aboriginal man accused of murdering a white woman. Others in the expedition are the Follower, a greenhorn trooper, the Veteran, and the Tracker.

Matt spends the night with a girl in an elevator during power outage in a girls' college dorm. He never sees her. Waking up in the morning, panties are all that's left of her. How does he find her in a building with 100 girls?
Ana's father sends her from her comfortable city life to live with grandma in the countryside as punishment. She struggles with rural life - muddy paths, poor internet, and unfamiliar local ways.
His life was emotionally closed off from the world, until an orphaned baby showed up at his house.
A young woman inherits a run-down pub and discovers a dark secret within its basement - Baghead - a shape-shifting creature that will let you speak to lost loved ones, but not without consequence.
A resurrected Egyptian mummy searches Cairo for the girl he believes to be his long-lost princess.
Survivors of a nuclear attack are grouped together for days in the basement of their apartment building, where fear and dwindling supplies wear away at their dynamic.
A group of troublemaking boys decide to take a stand when terrorists seize control of their boarding school.

A rowdy, unorthodox Santa Claus is fighting to save his declining business. Meanwhile, Billy, a neglected and precocious 12 year old, hires a hit man to kill Santa after receiving a lump of coal in his stocking.
While passing through a vacation resort, a newlywed couple encounters a mysterious, strikingly beautiful countess and her aide.
First mate Fletcher Christian leads a revolt against his sadistic commander, Captain Bligh, in this classic seafaring adventure, based on the real-life 1789 mutiny.

Lee Du-Seok publishes an autobiography describing murders he committed after the statute of limitations expires. A detective and one of the victims' mother search for the author while an anonymous person claims to be the real killer.
Follows one memorable night in the life of LAPD officer Ray Mandel as he hunts two cop killers on the loose.

In 1989 Rajasthan, IPS officer Patnaik raids a palace but fails. After requesting a bribe, he's transferred to Bhoj, where he investigates Dada Bhai, a respected local figure. Suspended after a failed raid, he uncovers hidden truths.
A gay couple's marriage is thrown into crisis when one of them impulsively begins a passionate affair with a young woman.
Legendary rock band Foo Fighters move into an Encino mansion steeped in grisly rock and roll history to record their much anticipated 10th album.
Chief Brody's widow believes that her family is deliberately being targeted by another shark in search of revenge.
Two documentary filmmakers attempt to penetrate a cult who worships a woman who claims to be from the future.
Two brothers, disinherited and desperate for cash, journey into the Canadian wilds to find themselves, their people and their fortune.
A young gymnast, who tries desperately to please her demanding mother, discovers a strange egg. She hides it and keeps it warm, but when it hatches, what emerges shocks them all.

In the 1970s, Om, an aspiring actor, is murdered, but is immediately reincarnated into the present day. He attempts to discover the mystery of his demise and find Shanti, the love of his previous life.
A sharp look at the American South's unreconciled history through Natchez, a Mississippi town that mixes antebellum tourism with a community deeply divided over its past.

movies.originalTitle: Året jag slutade prestera och började onanera
movies.plot: Goal-oriented Hanna wants another child before it is too late, but unexpectedly her boyfriend breaks up with her, and Hanna's world collapses. Hanna begins to realize that she may be chasing the wrong things in life.
During the 1800s, a safari guide, two elephant hunters and their crew run into trouble with the natives in the South African veld when they refuse to offer gifts to the tribesmen.
On a lonely road, a prison transport is brutally assaulted. Martin, the policeman who was driving, survives and fortifies his position while the con men search for a way to finish him.
A traumatised ex-con working as a driver for his pimp former cellmate forms an unlikely bond with a young sex worker, as they both try to escape the cycle of poverty, crime, and violence.

Michel passes the time by picking pockets, careful to never be caught despite being watched by the police. His friend Jacques may suspect, while both men may have their eyes on Jeanne, the pretty neighbor of Michel's ailing mother.
England 1959. In a small East Anglian town, Florence Green decides, against polite but ruthless local opposition, to open a bookshop.
Two brothers and their wives meet for dinner to discuss how to deal with a violent crime committed by their children.
In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father Reverend Samuel Clayton while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.
A Turkish man travels to Istanbul to find the daughter of his father's former girlfriend.
When a young man accidentally kills someone, he is plunged into a rich man's world of blackmail, betrayal, adultery and ...murder.

movies.primaryTitle: Kesari Chapter 2: The Untold Story of Jallianwala Bagh
movies.originalTitle: Kesari Chapter 2: The Untold Story of Jallianwala Bagh
movies.plot: After learning the truth behind the brutal massacre at the Jallianwala Bagh, C Sankaran Nair, a member of the Viceroy's Council, sets out to challenge the Crown and the military general responsible.

movies.primaryTitle: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
movies.originalTitle: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
movies.plot: When an alien with amazing powers crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm, Shaun the Sheep goes on a mission to shepherd the intergalactic visitor home before a sinister organization can capture her.
A young man's peculiar upbringing renders him unable to competently cope with the struggle of growing up.
An Israeli film director interviews fellow veterans of the 1982 invasion of Lebanon to reconstruct his own memories of his term of service in that conflict.

Two parallel stories about characters trapped in illogical endless spaces: two brothers and a detective locked on an infinite staircase, and a family locked on an infinite road - for a very long time.
The use of AI technology reaches its most violent and bloody conclusion after a series of deepfake videos are unleashed into the world.
On a trip to a Mexican border town, three college friends stumble upon a human-sacrifice cult.
The story of a sixteen-year-old boy, a badminton player from a village named Vellathooval in Idukki, who dreams of the Olympics.

Convinced that a divorce would separate her from her little girl, Zohra cannot bring herself to leave her husband despite his violent behavior. She suffers his blows in silence. But all that changes when she meets Chang Sue.
Three different soldiers - a woman and two men - return from war and facing the peaceful life's problems of each other.
A gangster known as "Samurai" wants to turn the waterfront of Rome into a new Las Vegas. All the local mob bosses have agreed to work for this common goal. But peace is not to last long.

A group of young shopping mall employees stay behind for a late night party in one of the stores. When the mall goes on lock-down before they can get out, the robot security system malfunctions, and goes on a killing spree.
When a field (which has been farmed by the McCabe family for generations) goes up for auction, the patriarch of the McCabe family will stop at nothing to prevent a rich American from buying it.

Clémence, a lawyer, leaves her marriage to embrace her true self. Her ex-husband fights for custody of their son Paul, manipulating him. As their relationship deteriorates, Clémence struggles to maintain her maternal bond.
A man is murdered when checking authenticity of ancient Egyptian jewelry at a museum. Adrienne finds out after the death of her husband, that he was using a fake name. Are the 2 deaths linked?
A single woman takes the place of a stranger's blind date and finds the perfect man for her.
Set in a burlesque world of 1940s Paris, a man is forced to flee Vienna as Nazi hysteria takes hold.
Obsessed with Pride and Prejudice (1995), a woman travels to a Jane Austen theme park in search for her perfect gentleman.

movies.primaryTitle: Aristotle and Dante Discover the Secrets of the Universe
movies.originalTitle: Aristotle and Dante Discover the Secrets of the Universe
movies.plot: Mexican teenagers Aristotle Mendoza and Dante Quintana explore their friendship while struggling with racial and ethnic identity, sexuality and family relationships in 1987 El Paso, Texas.

A failed work opportunity prompts chronically single Grace to pursue a one night stand with a stranger. Turns out he's an on-the-outs professional athlete in town with a problem of his own. Maybe they can help each other.

movies.primaryTitle: The Life and Times of Judge Roy Bean
movies.originalTitle: The Life and Times of Judge Roy Bean
movies.plot: In Vinegaroon, Texas, former outlaw Roy Bean appoints himself the judge for the region and dispenses his brand of justice as he sees fit.

What did little Eve see--and how will it haunt her? Husband, father and womanizer, Louis Batiste, is the head of an affluent family, but it's the women who rule this gothic world of secrets, lies and mystic forces.
A great white shark hunts the crew of a capsized sailboat along the Great Barrier Reef.
A man and woman are drawn together, entangled in the life cycle of an ageless organism. Identity becomes an illusion as they struggle to assemble the loose fragments of wrecked lives.
When a powerful politician falls for a strong-willed superstar, their passionate romance quickly spirals into a dangerous game of obsession, pride, and heartbreak.

When King Henry IV ascends to the throne, his heir, the Prince of Wales, is befriended by Sir John Falstaff, an old, overweight, fun-loving habitual liar. Through Falstaff's eyes we see the reign of King Henry IV and the rise of Henry V.
Widower Henry Hobson refuses to let his three daughters get married because he doesn't want to pay settlements, so they'll just have to outsmart him.
In a distant future scarce of water, space pirates get caught after stealing ice from a spaceship. They are sold to a princess looking for her dad. He might have found a planet abundant with water.
Young and impulsive Rosetta lives with her alcoholic mother. Moved by despair, she will do anything to maintain a job.
The population of a small town disappears and is replaced by aliens that chase human flesh for their intergalactic fast-food chain.
After being told that their children never existed, a man and woman soon discover there is a much bigger enemy at work.

The true story of three renowned racecar driver brothers, two embroiled in the 1980s IMSA scandal where drivers funded their racing careers through criminal means like drug trafficking and money laundering.
Four men plan a technically perfect crime, but the human element intervenes...
In future Tokyo, a young woman in the privatized police force tracks down her father's killer while battling against mutant rebels known as engineers.

Follows a fiercely independent landscape architect and a crisis-ridden bestselling novelist who, after a prickly first encounter in Paris, begin a sparky transatlantic exchange over books and recipes.
A journalist strikes up a romantic relationship with notorious drug lord Pablo Escobar.
A young Black man who is interning as a slave reenactor at a living history museum discovers that his white girlfriend's ancestors once owned his.
A lead detective being stalked by a serial killer is asked to check into a clinic treating law enforcement officials who can't face their jobs.

movies.primaryTitle: The People We Hate at the Wedding
movies.originalTitle: The People We Hate at the Wedding
movies.plot: Family tensions ramp up among siblings in the week leading up to their half-sister's wedding in the country.
The story of the notorious American labor union figure Jimmy Hoffa, who organizes a bitter strike, makes deals with members of the organized crime syndicate and mysteriously disappears in 1975.
In order to inherit a fortune a young woman agrees to marry a young man. She soon discovers that his family harbours a dark past involving a monstrous beast.
Senator Laine Hanson is a contender for U.S. Vice President, but information and disinformation about her past surfaces that threatens to derail her confirmation.

Terror grips a small mountain town as bodies are discovered after each full moon. Losing sleep, raising a teenage daughter, and caring for his ailing father, officer Marshall struggles to remind himself there's no such thing as werewolves.
An elderly couple fight against local authorities in rural New Brunswick to build their final home.
When a gunman enters an Apple Store in the heart of Amsterdam, the police face a delicate challenge to resolve the standoff. Based on true events.

After a single, career-minded woman is left on her own to give birth to the child of a married man, she finds a new romantic chance in a cab driver. Meanwhile, the point-of-view of the newborn baby is narrated through voice-over.
A jewel thief's daughter is kidnapped after he steals a collection of prized black diamonds, which aren't at all what they seem.

A man acquires an Artificially Intelligent android to cope with the loss of his recently deceased wife. In an attempt to create a truly sentient partner, he inadvertently turns a harmless lovebot into a deadly soulmate.
It tells the story of a newly pregnant couple who are forced to take in an ailing, estranged stepmother.
A superstar singer and her overworked personal assistant are presented with a choice that could alter the course of their respective careers.
When a terrorist escapes custody during a routine handover, Will Holloway must team with disgraced MI5 Intelligence Chief Harry Pearce to track him down before an imminent terrorist attack on London.

Godaan tells the story of Surbhi, an Indian cow who transforms a modern scientist's beliefs. Her presence leads to discoveries in Panchgavya-based medicine, sustainable living, and the spiritual science behind cow reverence.
A 24-year-old music critic gets romantically involved with members of an indie band she decides to publicize, set against Montreal's indie music scene in 2011.
A film about Mark David Chapman in the days leading up to the infamous murder of Beatle John Lennon.
A drama with a two-tiered storyline concerning a mother and daughter who try to form a bond after the young woman's difficult childhood.

movies.primaryTitle: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
movies.originalTitle: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
movies.plot: A group of high-schoolers invite Mandy Lane, an innocent, desirable girl, to a weekend party on a secluded ranch. While the festivities rage on, the number of revelers begins to drop mysteriously.
A failed American sales rep looks to recoup his losses by traveling to Saudi Arabia and selling his company's product to a wealthy monarch.
While recovering in Venice, sickly composer Gustav von Aschenbach becomes dangerously fixated with teenager Tadzio.
In 1880s Australia, after young Jim Craig's father dies, he takes a job at the Harrison cattle ranch, where he is forced to become a man.
Traveling con artist Harold Hill targets the naïve residents of a small town in 1910s Iowa by posing as a boys' band leader to raise money before he can skip town.
A Chennai interior designer's career struggles take an unexpected turn when bike pooling leads to romance with a fellow rider.

movies.originalTitle: Inran naru ichizoku: Dai-ni-shô - Zetsurin no hate ni
movies.plot: A new bride convinces everyone in her family to sleep with her.
Meet the jazz musicians, dancers, owner, and guests (like gangster Dutch Schultz) of The Cotton Club in 1928-1930s Harlem.
A shapeshifting student faces a moral crisis when his mentor offers to reunite him with his cougar family in exchange for false testimony, while danger lurks at Clearwater High.
Robin Hood, aging none too gracefully, returns exhausted from the Crusades to woo and win Maid Marian one last time.
Did you know that God is alive and lives in Brussels with his daughter?
Explores achievements of Eileen Collins, the first woman to pilot and command a spacecraft, paving the way for the next generation of female space explorers.
An aspiring young artist joins her high school track team and later discovers what real love feels like when she finds herself falling for an unexpected teammate.
Crunch Calhoun, a semi-reformed art thief, agrees to get his old gang back together to pull off one last heist.
A father struggles to keep his infant daughter alive in the wake of Hurricane Katrina.
The story of Adèle Hugo's unrequited love for a lieutenant.
Two scheming demon brothers, Wendell and Wild, enlist the aid of 13-year-old Kat Elliot to summon them to the Land of the Living.
An associate burns down a wax museum with the owner inside, but he survives only to become vengeful and murderous.
Based on the true-life experiences of Dave Fishwick; 'Bank of Dave' tells the story of how a working class Burnley man and self-made millionaire fought to set up a community bank.
Due to the pandemic, Parker and her best friend decide to quarantine at the family lake house alone - or so they think.
Hosho Academy High School students crash on an island with giant insects. Oribe Mutsumi and Matsuo Ayumi search for food, hoping for rescue in three days.
A couple from college get caught in a dangerous game of cat and mouse with a psychopathic hitchhiker and the police after witnessing a murder and being framed.
Several dancers come together in Las Vegas, battling for a victory that could define their dreams and their careers.
Janet hosts a party to celebrate her new promotion, but once the guests arrive, it becomes clear that not everything will be going down as smoothly as the red wine.
Three inseparable childhood friends are just out of college. Nothing comes between them - until they each fall in love, and their wildly different approaches to relationships creates tension.
Ten-year-old Opal adopts an unkempt dog she finds at a supermarket and names it Winn-Dixie. Soon, Opal and Winn Dixie befriend people who teach Opal about her mother and life.
After being caught robbing the college canteen, best friends Molshri and Shivang are expelled. To be reinstated, they must enroll five children from an impoverished slum into a local school.

movies.primaryTitle: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
movies.originalTitle: Friday the 13th Part VIII: Jason Takes Manhattan
movies.plot: Jason Voorhees is accidentally awakened from his watery grave and ends up stalking a ship full of graduating high-school students headed to Manhattan, New York.

Oliver, a film director, discovers on an erotic website that the protagonist of one of the videos is his younger half-sister Aurora. In the process of finding out what she was doing there, Oliver will become fascinated by Aurora.
After a traumatic accident, a woman becomes drawn to a mysterious abandoned carnival.
The lives of three homicide detectives are turned upside-down during a murder investigation.

Zed anticipates an athletic scholarship while Addison is gearing up for Seabrook's international cheer-off competition. Then suddenly, extraterrestrial beings appear around Seabrook, causing more than friendly competition.

M arrives in Helsinki only to be viciously attacked by thugs and pronounced dead by medics. He revives but with no memory of his past or his identity. He rebuilds his life from scratch, but the past inevitably catches up with him.

movies.primaryTitle: The King of Kong: A Fistful of Quarters
movies.plot: Die-hard gamers compete to break world records on classic arcade games.
This movie is a love story between an idealistic American nurse and a Turkish officer in World War I.
A hard-luck limo driver struggles to go straight and pay off a debt to his bookie. He takes on a job with a crazed passenger, whose sought-after ledger implicates some seriously dangerous criminals.
Things get out of control when Doman, an eager and saintly traffic cop, is asked the play the role of the bank robber in a robbery intervention police training program.
As Orson, The Authority's newest employee, finds himself trapped in the absurdities of corporate life, his alienation deepens when he discovers a room he's told doesn't exist.
A DJ with superpowers and his ladylove embark on a mission to protect the Brahmastra, a weapon of enormous energy, from dark forces closing in on them.
Alien gang leader Alpha One and her crew disguise themselves as 1950s bikers to invade Earth. Their conquest plan derails when they experience human emotions, complicating their mission.
After a journalist discovers his identity, a former Weather Underground activist goes on the run.
A best man stays on as a houseguest with the newlyweds, much to the couple's annoyance.

17-year-old Phil lives with his mother and twin sister in an old mansion on the outskirts of town. When he starts to feel attracted to a new boy at school, Phil is plunged into emotional turmoil only exacerbated by the trouble at home.
The residents of a suburban high-rise apartment building are infected by parasites that turn them into mindless nymphomaniac fiends.

An American priest working in Mexico is possessed during an exorcism and ends up committing a terrible act. Eighteen years later, the consequences of his sin come back to haunt him, unleashing the greatest battle within.
A dark reimagining of Pinocchio, this unsettling tale explores the eerie nature of the iconic puppet, blurring lines between reality and fantasy.
A humble clerk courts a woman who awaits her lover's return night after night.
A renowned actress teeters on the edge of a breakdown as she counts down the days toward a big Broadway opening.
A family seeks refuge on an isolated farm during a zombie apocalypse, but long-buried secrets strain their relationships as they struggle to survive.
Two teenage girls, Yin Jia and Tong Tong, share a life in vibrant Changsha, China. When Tong Tong becomes involved with a drug dealer, Yin Jia risks everything to keep her close.
Chronicles the many years of love and turmoil that bind Marianne and Johan through matrimony, infidelity, divorce, and subsequent partners.

William Tell is an ex-military interrogator living under the radar as a low-stakes gambler. When he encounters a young man looking to commit revenge against a mutual enemy, he takes him on the casino circuit to set him on a new path.
Three years after solving an Appalachian mystery about a hidden box in East Tennessee's mountains, discovered footage reveals a film crew's journey.

movies.primaryTitle: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
movies.originalTitle: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
movies.plot: A decade post-death, filmmaker William Greaves reveals his final work: footage of a 1972 gathering he arranged with Harlem Renaissance legends, which he deemed his most significant capture.
In 2024 a pandemic ravages the world and its cities. Centering on a handful of people as they navigate the obstacles currently hindering society: disease, martial law, quarantine, and vigilantes.

Stranded in rural Italy without transportation or language skills, an American couple on the verge of adopting tries to reconnect during a disastrous vacation, as their fears and relationship problems threaten to boil over.

A teenage boy expelled from school for fighting arrives at a boarding school where the systematic bullying of younger students is encouraged as a means to maintain discipline, and decides to fight back.
A young woman is murdered in the White House. Homicide detective Regis investigates while Secret Service works against him. He's assigned agent Chance. She eventually cooperates after a man's framed.
Manu and Priya hail from a middle-class background and fall in love. When circumstances land Manu in jail, his relationship with Priya is put in jeopardy.
An unhinged office worker who planned to go on a shooting spree at his workplace struggles with his newfound status as a hero after he ends up stopping a shooting spree instead.
An illustrious British boarding school becomes a bloody battleground when a mysterious sinkhole appears at a nearby fracking site, unleashing unspeakable horror.
A weak high school student and a mighty gangster exchange their bodies accidentally.
At a Mexican border drug deal, dealers Griff and Abbott meet for an exchange. Both unexpectedly flash badges - Griff's FBI, Abbott's DEA - revealing they're unknowingly working the same case.

An explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of misfits and visionaries who had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

Follows a married couple of 17 years. The husband is an architect who accepts a controversial project to build a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire. This decision leads his wife to question their marriage.
In dystopian Khansaar, two characters navigate a complex relationship amid power struggles and shifting alliances. Their journey unfolds in a tense, futuristic world filled with conflict and drama.

A hearing-impaired girl is visited by the Virgin Mary and can suddenly hear, speak, and heal the sick. As people flock to witness her miracles, terrifying events unfold. Are they the work of the Virgin Mary or something much more sinister?
Hopefuls try out before a demanding director for a part in a new musical.

A kennel owner, grappling with climate anxiety, falls in love with a customer service rep over the phone. Amid a natural disaster, he embarks on an adventurous, bilingual romantic journey to find her.
A reclusive, blind photojournalist lives quietly in a New York penthouse, until a smooth but sadistic criminal looking for a hidden fortune enters her life.
A teenage girl in the Midwest becomes infected by an outbreak of a disease that slowly turns the infected into cannibalistic zombies. During her transformation, her loving father stays by her side.
A young couple's enduring love is tested when 27-year-old Su-jin is diagnosed with a rare form of Alzheimer's disease.
A woman becomes very curious about one of her psychiatrist husband's inmates, a man who was found guilty of the murder and disfigurement of his former wife.
A retired detective accepts a simple task, unaware that it will tear open old, forgotten, but deadly wounds.
Delves into a man's relentless quest for vengeance since youth, driven by righting past wrongs, shaping his very existence. Viewers experience the complexities of his tumultuous vendetta journey.
CEO Lucy takes her staff on corporate team building in some underground desert caves in New Mexico. They get stuck there.
A newly divorced sober mom goes to a wedding with a much younger date and behaves like a drunk 25 year old bridesmaid to try and keep up.

The story of two men on different sides of a prison riot -- the inmate leading the rebellion and the young guard trapped in the revolt, who poses as a prisoner in a desperate attempt to survive the ordeal.
A mute gunman helps townspeople fight corrupt and tyrannical authorities.
The theory that it was in fact Edward De Vere, Earl of Oxford, who penned Shakespeare's plays. Set against the backdrop of the succession of Queen Elizabeth I and the Essex rebellion against her.
A Welsh journalist breaks the news in the western media of the famine in Ukraine in the early 1930s.
Abhirami seeks her missing fiancé Kiran, joining forces with journalist Aswin. Their investigation reveals an intricate web of secrets, drawing them into a mystery more complex than anticipated.
The children of a once famous artist hire a forger to complete some unfinished, long ago abandoned canvases so they'll have an inheritance when he dies.
In 1956, Ernesto 'Che' Guevara and a band of Castro-led Cuban exiles mobilize an army to topple the regime of dictator Fulgencio Batista.
A struggling actress tries to help a friend prove his innocence after he's accused of murdering the husband of a high-society entertainer.
A couple's wedding day turns horrific as some of the guests start showing signs of a strange illness.
Using only a hammer and a chisel, a man spends twenty-two years carving a road through a treacherous mountain.
Six strangers awake trapped inside a loft with no memory of how they got there. Time counts down as the 6 confront secrets, suspicion, and themselves in a tense, character-driven mystery.
Based on real events, Francesc Boix is a Spaniard inmate in the Nazi concentration camp of Mauthausen in Austria who tries to save the evidences of the horrors committed inside its walls.
A group of junior high kids don't want to go to summer camps chosen by their parents. They make their own adult-free camp and "hire" an ex drama teacher to help.

movies.primaryTitle: Antrum: The Deadliest Film Ever Made
movies.originalTitle: Antrum: The Deadliest Film Ever Made
movies.plot: A young boy and girl enter the forest to dig a hole to Hell. Said to be a cursed film from the late 1970s, "Antrum" examines the horrifying power of storytelling.
Gi Cheol and Yoo Jin work together to find the missing girl, but traces of her are disappearing.
Firebird follows a handsome, soulful young soldier who embarks on a clandestine sexual affair with a charismatic fighter pilot on a Soviet Air Force Base at the height of 1970's Communist rule.
When a teen is bullied, his brother and friends lure the bully into the woods to seek revenge.
A failed cricketer decides to revive his cricketing career in his late 30's despite everyone being skeptical of his ability to do so.
An American veteran who got involved with a young woman from Naples during World War II returns to the same city in the early 1970s to meet his son, who has no interest in his father.
A teenage boy comes back from the dead because he is determined to win the most beautiful girl in school.

The love of high school sweethearts Deanie and Bud is weighed down by the oppressive expectations of their parents and society in smalltown Kansas in 1928, threatening the future of their relationship.
A young boy refuses to accept his mother's new boyfriend despite his attempts to win his respect. Meanwhile, the disgruntled relative of a criminal he prosecuted seeks revenge.
A determined taxi driver in Lagos forms an unexpected bond with a group of free-spirited women, leading her into a world of friendship and self-discovery despite the risks along the way.
A high school teacher in Austin, Texas takes sexual advantage over one of her students. Her life begins to unravel as the details of the relationship are exposed.
Facing cancer, Oscar trains his disabled son Billy in grocery bagging, hoping to secure him a job and independence before time runs out.
During World War II, several oddly assorted military experts are teamed in a mission to raid and destroy a bridge vital to enemy strategy.
In 1973, a young gallery assistant goes on a wild adventure behind the scenes as he helps the aging genius Salvador Dali prepare for a big show in New York.
Down-on-his-luck Siddharth faces loss after loss until meeting Shravya, a single mom who brings hope. As he works to rebuild and find love, his troubled past threatens to derail everything.
Following the death of a family member, a mother and son experience mysterious events which distort their sense of reality and make them question their sanity.
In a small Midwestern town, a deadly annual ritual unfolds when the mythical nightmare, Sawtooth Jack, rises from the cornfields and challenges the town’s teenage boys in a bloody battle of survival.
While travelling the countryside to locate his nephew, a small town doctor finds himself interacting with people from his past and future.
Cruella DeVil gets out of prison and goes after the puppies once more.
In the aftermath of a roadside accident, the line between the living and the dead collapses for a mother, a daughter and a stranger.
A sex-addicted con-man pays for his mother's hospital bills by playing on the sympathies of those who rescue him from choking to death.
An uptight, middle-aged, repressed woman turns into a sex addict after getting hit on the head, and she then falls into an underground subculture of sex addicts in suburban Baltimore.

An investigation into the life and mysterious fate of Swedish diplomat Raoul Wallenberg, who risked everything to save thousands of Jews from certain death in the final days of World War II, only to then vanish into Russian prison forever.
A couple celebrates their son's birthday in the middle of the ocean on their boat. A violent storm hits and it brings up hungry creatures from the depths and they fight for their survival.

The future for the last remaining pub, The Old Oak, in a village of Northeast England, where people are leaving the land as the mines are closed. Houses are cheap and available, thus making it an ideal location for Syrian refugees.

"Elvira: Mistress of the Dark" is a 1988 comedy, horror movie - upon arriving in a small town where Elvira has inherited a rundown mansion, the famous horror host must battle an evil uncle, and townspeople who want her burned at the stake.
Following a tragic car accident in Greece, an American tourist finds himself at the center of a dangerous political conspiracy and on the run for his life.

Three years after he last terrorized his sister, Michael Myers confronts her again, before traveling to Haddonfield to deal with the cast and crew of a reality show which is being broadcast from his old home.
In 1987 Tokyo, a quirky and sensitive 11-year-old girl copes with a terminally ill father and stressed-out working mother while encountering various adults dealing with their own struggles.
Three friends are asked to be bridesmaids at a wedding of a woman they used to ridicule back in high school.
Four eminent Indian directors explore sex, desire and love through short films in this sequel to 2018's Emmy-nominated "Lust Stories".

Martin's daughter, Emma, takes up a night watch job to find out what happened to her parents almost thirty years ago. A meeting with Wörmer in his cell pulls the serial killer out of his coma and sets in motion a chain of fateful events.
In 1890s London, two friends use the same pseudonym ("Ernest") for their on-the-sly activities. Hilarity ensues.

movies.primaryTitle: An American Tail: Fievel Goes West
movies.originalTitle: An American Tail: Fievel Goes West
movies.plot: Fievel's family decides to move out to the West, unaware that they are falling into a trap perpetrated by a smooth-talking cat.

Inspired by the story of a refugee, the horrendous conditions before his heroic journey, the heartbreaking indifference confronting him along the way, and the uplifting power and humanity found in hope, truth and justice.
After World War II, Harry Haft is a boxer who fought against his peers in concentration camps. Haunted by memories, he tries to use fighting legends as a way to find his love.
In December 1914, an unofficial Christmas truce on the Western Front allows soldiers from opposing sides of the First World War to gain insight into each other's way of life.

When a successful country lawyer captures and attempts to "civilize" the last remaining member of a violent clan that has roamed the Northeast coast for decades, he puts the lives of his family in jeopardy.

Charles, a bored civil servant struggling through a harsh Utah winter, spends most of his time reflecting on his romance with Laura, a coworker who left him to return to her husband, an A-Frame salesman.
After a tragic accident, a man conjures up a towering, vengeful demon called Pumpkinhead to destroy a group of unsuspecting teenagers.
A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.
The fabled Spanish hero Rodrigo Diaz de Vivar (a.k.a. El Cid) overcomes a family vendetta and court intrigue to defend Christian Spain against the Moors.
When neurotic bedridden wife Leona Stevenson overhears a murder plot on her telephone, she tries to piece the puzzle together and prevent the murder. Based on Lucille Fletcher's famous radio play.

movies.primaryTitle: Adolf Hitler: The Greatest Story Never Told
movies.originalTitle: Adolf Hitler: The Greatest Story Never Told
movies.plot: Adolf Hitler, born in Braunau, a man who will forever change the history of the world.
In 1937 Nevada, silver mine caretaker Jess Tyler is reunited with his teenage daughter Kady who will do anything to persuade Jess to let her have claim to the mine.
A middle-class husband struggles to accept his wife's modern, progressive attitudes, creating tension in their marriage.
Two young professionals navigate marriage and career dreams until a devastating incident with their neighbors tests their bond and values.
A book editor has an affair with a high-tech voyeur in an exclusive Manhattan apartment building.
A college student suspects a series of bizarre deaths are connected to certain urban legends.
The rise and fall of confederate general Thomas "Stonewall" Jackson, as he meets with military success against the Union from 1861 to 1863, when he is accidentally killed by his own soldiers.

movies.primaryTitle: Divine Secrets of the Ya-Ya Sisterhood
movies.originalTitle: Divine Secrets of the Ya-Ya Sisterhood
movies.plot: After years of mother-daughter tension, Siddalee receives a scrapbook detailing the wild adventures of the "Ya-Yas", her mother's girlhood friends.

The mother of a feudal lord's only heir is kidnapped away from her husband by the lord. The husband and his samurai father must decide whether to accept the unjust decision, or risk death to get her back.
A typical Italian-American family meets their son's new girlfriend.

movies.originalTitle: Chi bi: Jue zhan tian xia
movies.plot: Second and final part of epic tale about a legendary battle that changed the course of China history.
A young woman goes searching for her missing artist father. Her journey takes her to a strange Californian seaside town governed by a mysterious undead cult.

In a strange world where people share numerous deformities, the same problem we all face challenges each of them: to find someone who accepts you as you are. Sometimes, that means finding yourself first.
Journalist Anne Roland explores the disturbing links behind her friend's sudden disappearance, an ominous government research chemical, and a disturbing radio broadcast of unknown origin.
A criminal defense attorney, unhappy in her marriage, finds herself seduced by her mysterious new client, an artist accused of murdering his girlfriend.
A woman opts for a cloning procedure after she receives a terminal diagnosis but when she recovers her attempts to have her clone decommissioned fail, leading to a court-mandated duel to the death.
A polar bear's traditional migration path leads it into populated areas, sparking conflict between human interests and wild nature as the animal struggles to survive in a changing world.

Marlon Brando pulls idealistic Los Angeles architect Bernard Judge from his ordinary life and persuades him to design the world's first ecologically perfect retreat on a tiny, inhospitable Tahitian island.
A hiking trip into the wild turns into a desperate bid for survival for five friends on the run from a mysterious shooter.

In the weeks following an apocalyptic event, a husband and wife venture across the countryside inhabited by deadly factions in search of safety, and must work together as they are pushed to the breaking point in order to survive.

A team of navy personnel stationed at a temporary base at the bottom of the ocean and tasked with setting up nuclear missiles discovers a huge underwater cavern which houses a giant prehistoric creature.

A small town on the coast of Galicia, is shaken two years ago by the shipwreck in which seven of its nine crew members died. After two years of mourning, they decide to return rondalla, which brings a lot of joy and excitement.

Two actresses, Béatrice Dalle and Charlotte Gainsbourg, are on a film set telling stories about witches - but that's not all. 'Lux Æterna' is also an essay on cinema, the love of film, and on-set hysterics.

movies.primaryTitle: The Ballad of Jack and Rose
movies.originalTitle: The Ballad of Jack and Rose
movies.plot: A father and daughter isolated on an island off the East Coast and living on a once-thriving commune grapple with the limits of family and sexuality.
A big-budget epic follows a man facing financial abuse who must overcome his struggles before he can tackle bigger challenges. His destiny hangs in the balance.
A police detective cracks down on organized crime in Chinatown after the murders of Triad and Mafia leaders.
Patricia "Trish" Weir is committed to putting her kidnapper and rapist Ernesto Miranda in prison, while her life is destroyed by the legal system.
A journalist investigates Carlo Gambino's legacy after his death, exploring how this Sicilian butcher's son became NYC's quiet but ruthless crime boss, through accounts of those who knew him.
Two feuding half-sisters will have to spend New Year's Eve together at their late father's beach house.
The young attendees of a space camp find themselves in space for real when their shuttle is accidentally launched into orbit.
Two boys learn from a mysterious warrior that they are the heirs to the throne of Patusan and set out to overthrow the current monarchy.
The ritual murder of a young woman at the archaeological sites of Atapuerca unleashes psychosis in the small town that already experienced a similar trauma six years ago.
The story of the nobleman-turned-outlaw hero who was crowned king of Scots in the 14th century.

movies.primaryTitle: The Man Who Fell to Earth
movies.originalTitle: The Man Who Fell to Earth
movies.plot: An alien must pose as a human to save his dying planet, but a woman and greed of other men create complications.

Tim and John fell in love at their all-boys high school. Their romance endured for 15 years to laugh in the face of everything life threw at it - the separations, the discrimination, the temptations, the jealousies and the losses.

A spy thriller following covert operatives as they uncover a surveillance conspiracy that escalates into a national security emergency, racing against time to dismantle the network before it silences opposition.
Elwood must reunite the old band, with a few new members, and go on another "Mission from God."
Set in 1999 Los Angeles, veteran police officer Dave Brown, the last of the renegade cops, works to take care of his family, and struggles for his own survival.
A Wild West showman and his crew find dinosaurs in Mexico.
Desperate to provide care for her daughter, down-on-her-luck Jean moves in with her father in-law from whom she is estranged. Through time, they learn to forgive each other and heal old wounds.

After outrunning a typhoon at sea, a strong-willed tugboat navigator and her crew discover a high-tech alien life form that's taken control of a Russian research vessel and aims to destroy on a massive scale.
Maria inherits a book of secrets from her dad. She moves to her uncle's Moonacre estate. A family curse was cast on the valley. Only Maria can break it using her book.
A couple swap city life for the country, but their picturesque new hometown turns out to be just a little bit different to what they were expecting.
A group of young travelers are stranded on an island in the Pacific where they struggle to escape an evil presence that has been kept hidden from mankind for centuries.

movies.primaryTitle: The Boy in the Iron Box
movies.originalTitle: The Boy in the Iron Box
movies.plot: A plane carrying a team of mercenaries crashes on a remote snowy summit. They come across a maze-like stone fortress, and terror takes a new shape.
During World War II, an Englishwoman opens her heart to an evacuee after initially resolving to be rid of him in this moving journey of womanhood, love and friendship.

At the peak of her career in London, an Australian woman is diagnosed with MS. After losing her job and the death of her husband, she moves home with her three sons, where a chance encounter with a childhood sweetheart changes her life.

Karen O'Connor, a young journalist known for her celebrity profiles, is consumed with discovering the truth behind a long-buried incident that affected the lives and careers of showbiz team Vince Collins and Lanny Morris.
A woman navigates the complex journey of motherhood while confronting her deepest fears and anxieties.

Charlie, a notorious serial killer known as the Midnight Mangler finds himself trapped, reliving the same violent night over and over. Initially embracing his grisly urges, Charlie soon becomes desperate to escape the endless nightmare.

Reserved and solitary, young Lucas lives with his religious aunt in a tranquil country town. When his aunt charitably agrees to let his cousin, Mario, fresh out of jail, stay for a while, mischief and joy affect the whole little community.

When her younger brother Charlie unexpectedly disappears into the magical, animated universe of PLAYMOBIL®, unprepared Marla must go on a quest of a lifetime to bring him home, setting off on a fantastic journey across stunning new worlds.
Bullied for wanting to be an idol, Kenji finds belonging in a cabaret and help from a trailblazing doctor, emerging onstage as her true self, Ai Haruna.
A murder plot hatched by two men who meet on a train is considered to be a joke by one of them, and a dangerously real plan by the other.

Kevin suffers from a Morquio's syndrome, which weakens his heart and stunts his growth. Maxwell has dyslexia and towers above his classmates. The two couldn't be more different, but, when Kevin is asked to help Maxwell, they soon bond.
A team of brave individuals risk their lives to protect the last mountain gorillas.

Rufus T. Firefly is named the dictator of bankrupt Freedonia and declares war on neighboring Sylvania over the love of his wealthy backer Mrs. Teasdale, contending with two inept spies who can't seem to keep straight which side they're on.
A Russian American ballet dancer's airplane is forced to land in USSR, where he's "repatriated". He stays with an American man married to a Russian. Will the American help him flee USSR?
A 28-year-old billionaire senses his empire collapsing around him.
A cinematic odyssey exploring David Bowie's creative and musical journey. From visionary filmmaker Brett Morgen, and sanctioned by the Bowie estate.
Lonely, misanthropic small-time crook Enzo uses the superpowers gained after falling into the Tiber River to chase down a crazy gangster called "The Gypsy."

White filmmaker Rob Bliss walks 1500 miles across the US wearing a Black Lives Matter t-shirt. He is challenged by Trump supporters and encounters both deep hostility and unexpected moments of connection.
A plane has engine trouble while flying over a jungle inhabited by cannibals.
Three women, who've been friends since childhood, meet at university in Dublin in 1957. Student and boyfriend life begins.
48 hours of intersecting lives and crimes in Los Angeles.
In 1937, in São Paulo, 12-year-old Hugo comes from Santa Catarina. His grandmother is returning him to his mother, Anna, who is now with Osmar, the most influential politician in the state.
A historical drama that illustrates Russian author Leo Tolstoy's (Christopher Plummer's) struggle to balance fame and wealth with his commitment to a life devoid of material things.
Danger, deception and murder descend upon a sleepy town when a professional assassin accepts a new assignment from his enigmatic boss.
An American widow finds unexpected love with a man living wild on Hampstead Heath when they take on the developers who want to destroy his home.
A group of skinheads become alarmed at the way their neighbourhood is changing.
When a hypochondriac learns that he is dying, he accepts an offer to throw himself in a volcano at a tropical island, and along the way there, learns to truly live.
On Thursday 9 November 1961, a man named Brian descended the stairs to a cellar in Liverpool and changed the world forever.
When a lottery winner dies of shock, his fellow townsfolk attempt to claim the money.

Madame M, kidnaps forty pre-teen girls to train them as the most deadly assassins. CIA operative follows the case for 6 years with no leads, but when a series of assassinations begin to occur, he suspects that Madame M is back in business.

movies.primaryTitle: Berserk: The Golden Age Arc I - The Egg of the King
movies.originalTitle: Berserk: Ougon Jidai-hen I - Haou no Tamago
movies.plot: A lone sellsword named Guts gets recruited into a mercenary band and attempts to help the Band's leader, Griffith, on his rise to power.

When a routine traffic stop results in the unexplained, grisly death of her colleague, a cop realizes footage of the incident will play for her eyes only. As the attacks mount, she races to understand the supernatural force behind them.
Actor and politician begin affair, develop public sex fetish. As fame beckons, they crave riskier encounters.
In 1913, the charming, seductive and sinister vampire Count Dracula travels to England in search of an immortal bride.
A senior chef lives with his three grown daughters; the middle one finds her future plans affected by unexpected events and the life changes of the other household members.
Surviving victims of Michael Myers form a vigilante mob and vow to end his reign of terror.
A drama based on the experiences of Kathryn Bolkovac, a Nebraska cop who served as a peacekeeper in post-war Bosnia and outed the U.N. for covering up a sex trafficking scandal.

movies.primaryTitle: Garfield: A Tail of Two Kitties
movies.originalTitle: Garfield: A Tail of Two Kitties
movies.plot: Jon and Garfield visit the United Kingdom, where a case of mistaken cat identity finds Garfield ruling over a castle. His reign is soon jeopardized by the nefarious Lord Dargis, who has designs on the estate.
Boris Karloff hosts a trio of horror stories about a stalked call girl, a vampire-like monster who preys on his family, and a nurse who is haunted by her ring's rightful owner.
A semi-autobiographical story about Hubert as a young homosexual at odds with his mother.
During the colorful Panagbenga festival, a young girl discovers love and sexuality through innocent eyes.

In the near future, breathable air is nonexistent and two engineers tasked with guarding the last hope for mankind struggle to preserve their own lives while administering to their vital task at hand.
A man travels around a city with a camera slung over his shoulder, documenting urban life with dazzling invention.
A young Australian reporter tries to navigate the political turmoil of Indonesia during the rule of President Sukarno with the help of a diminutive photographer.
A look at how climate change affects our environment and what society can do to prevent the demise of endangered species, ecosystems and native communities across the planet.

movies.primaryTitle: Who's That Knocking at My Door
movies.originalTitle: Who's That Knocking at My Door
movies.plot: A young man can't accept the girl he likes because of her bitter past.
The story of Michael Ausiello and Kit Cowan's relationship, which takes a tragic turn when Cowan is diagnosed with terminal cancer.
After the events at Lake Victoria, the pre-historic school of blood-thirsty piranhas make their way into a newly opened waterpark.

Mexican beauty Camilla Lopez (Salma Hayek) hopes to rise above her station by marrying a wealthy American. That is complicated by meeting Arturo Bandini (Colin Farrell), a first-generation Italian hoping to land a writing career and a blue-eyed blonde on his arm.
After their bank heist goes wrong, a desperate criminal, his out-of-control brother, and their motley crew of ex-marines must escape New Orleans and the determined FBI agent who pursues them.
A wounded Revolutionary War soldier takes shelter with a Pennsylvania trapper and his son. As British troops approach, they face choices about loyalty and survival in the wilderness.
A follow-up to the film Iron Sky (2012) in which Nazis plan to take over the world after lying dormant in a secret military base on the moon.
A self-absorbed realtor enlists the help of his neighbor when he's suddenly left in charge of the granddaughter he never knew existed until his estranged son drops her off at his home.

April 1940. Norway has been invaded by Germany and the royal family and government have fled into the interior. The German envoy to Norway tries to negotiate a peace. Ultimately, the decision on Norway's future will rest with the king.
The sprightly young assistant of a Hollywood screenwriter helps him over his writer's block by acting out his fantasies of possible plots.
Police inspector Emilien and his taxi-driver pal Daniel are back, this time on the tail of a group of Japanese yakuza.
When Karen the Computer decides to take over the world, it's up to Plankton to stop her - with a little help from SpongeBob and the Gal Pals (Pearl, Sandy, and Mrs. Puff).

Officer Sandra Perron resigns from the Canadian military after a controversial photo surfaces. Adapting to civilian life amidst an investigation, she denies abuse allegations despite evidence suggesting mistreatment within her unit.
While attempting a burglary, charming house thief Harry stumbles upon Daisy and decides to save her from herself, which launches them both onto a darkly-comedic path of self discovery and love.
7 women find themselves dealing with a mystery killing. Who's the killer and what are the motives of the murder?
An all-star baseball player becomes the unhealthy focus of an obsessive salesman.
A heavily addicted smoker is unprepared for the true price he must pay when he asks a guru's help to kick the habit.
Max Keeble, the victim of his 7th grade class, plots revenge when he learns that he's moving, but it backfires when he isn't after all.
The story of the romance between the King of Siam and widowed British schoolteacher, Anna Leonowens, during the 1860s.
An ex-sportswriter is hired by a shady fight promoter to promote his latest find, an unknown but easily exploitable rising star from Argentina.

movies.primaryTitle: The NeverEnding Story II: The Next Chapter
movies.originalTitle: The Neverending Story II: The Next Chapter
movies.plot: A young boy with a distant father enters a world of make-believe and magic through a portal within an antique book.
In 1980, a teenage boy escapes the unrest in Iran only to face more hostility in America, due to the hostage crisis. Determined to fit in, he joins the school's floundering wrestling team.

movies.originalTitle: Bud Abbott Lou Costello Meet Frankenstein
movies.plot: The Wolf Man tries to warn a dimwitted porter that Dracula wants his brain for Frankenstein monster's body.
An N.Y.C. film school student accepts a job with a local mobster who resembles a famous cinema godfather and who takes the young man under his wing, after demanding total loyalty.
A corporate engineer develops a lucrative secret process for a company but doesn't know who to trust when the higher-ups seemingly want to steal it from him.
Held captive and faced with their imminent executions, fifty strangers are forced to choose the one person among them who deserves to live.

1940s Venice. After twenty years of marriage, a retired art critic and his younger wife feel their passion is waning. To help her shed her inhibitions and rekindle their relationship, the professor records his sexual fantasies in a diary.
In the hours surrounding a glamorous appearance at a championship boxing match, supermodel Anna Nicole Smith, her psychiatrist, and her lover form a disastrous trio and descend towards chaos.

movies.primaryTitle: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
movies.originalTitle: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
movies.plot: The story of Preston Tucker, the maverick car designer and his ill-fated challenge to the auto industry with his revolutionary car concept.
A young woman finds herself involved in a dangerous love triangle when she gets involved with the writer of a popular steamy novel.

In the ironically named city of Paradise, a loser teams up with his cult-leading uncle to steal a peculiar bounty of riches from their local amusement park. The recently arrived Taliban have a similar focus, but a far more sinister intent.

The human experience, portraying a single intense day. Examines how individuals are pushed to their limits as they defy constraints, whether from self-imposed restrictions, familial expectations, or societal pressures.

An unfaithful newly-wed wife, an estranged father, a priest and an angry son suddenly find themselves in the most unexpected predicaments, each poised to experience their destiny, all on one fateful day.
A newspaper photographer researches an 1873 double homicide and finds her own life paralleling that of a witness who survived the tragic ordeal.

movies.primaryTitle: The Girl from the Other Side
movies.plot: Once upon a time, in a far, faraway place, there were two lands. The world was divided into an inner land and an outer land. People feared the outer land. Inhabited by eerie beings, the carriers of curse. One day on the border to the inner land inhabited by humans, one such being find a girl on heaps of abandoned dead bodies. The girl says her name is Shiva and shows affection to the "being" who found her, calling him "Teacher". This is a story of two people; one human, one inhuman, who linger in the hazy twilight that separates night from day.
American journalist Paul Kemp takes on a freelance job in Puerto Rico for a local newspaper during the 1960s and struggles to find a balance between island culture and the expatriates who live there.
A family inherits a house with 12 ghosts who want a 13th.
The adventures and misadventures of a group of patients with OCD appointed at the same time.
Journalist Shiori Ito investigates her own sexual assault, seeking to prosecute the high-profile offender. Her quest becomes a landmark case, exposing Japan's outdated judicial and societal systems.

Circumstances force a tough single mother and her two daughters into a life of crime and they quickly become outlaws on the run, picking up partners along the way, and traveling to different states, pursued by the law.
An exploration of one's relationships with food, sexuality, and revenge. It asks, "How far would you go in the name of love?"
American seminary student Michael Kovak travels to Italy to take an exorcism course.
Victorian London is terrorized by an unknown serial killer who leaves cryptic messages with the victim's blood. When the killings increase, Scotland Yard assigns the case to a famous inspector.
When a stagecoach guard tries to warn a town of an imminent raid by a band of outlaws, the people mistake him for one of the gang

Guided by James Dean, the eternal symbol of youthful rebellion, a gawky high school student obsessed with the hottest girl in class takes a crash course in teenage coolness from his motorcycle-rebel neighbor.
A former L.A. drug dealer tries to go straight but his past and his underworld connections bring him into the focus of the DEA, the Mexican feds and the Mexican drug cartels.
Bigna and Frank are two people of different thoughts. When their different worlds collide they become obsessively entwined in a passionate affair.
In the throes of a zombie apocalypse, a troubled woman from Las Vegas with a dark past finds herself stranded in the desert with a lone and ravenous zombie on her tail.
The ethereally beautiful Vicky recalls her romances with Hao Hao and Jack in the neon-lit clubs of Taipei.

France before 1789: When a widow hears that her lover is to marry her cousin's daughter, she asks the playboy Valmont to take the girl's virginity. But first she bets him, with her body as prize, to seduce a virtuous, young, married woman.
A gender-queer punk-rock singer from East Berlin tours the U.S. with her band as she tells her life story and follows the former lover/band-mate who stole her songs.
A man who has made a new life for himself and the daughter left on his doorstep 6 years ago finds his family threatened when the birth mother resurfaces.

movies.primaryTitle: I Am the Pretty Thing That Lives in the House
movies.originalTitle: I Am the Pretty Thing That Lives in the House
movies.plot: A nervous nurse who scares easily finds herself caring for an ailing horror novelist while living in a house with hidden secrets.

movies.primaryTitle: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
movies.originalTitle: Beneath the Planet of the Apes
movies.plot: The sole survivor of an interplanetary rescue mission searches for the only survivor of the previous expedition. He discovers a planet ruled by apes and an underground city run by telepathic humans.
After his mistress runs over a young teen, a Wall Street hotshot sees his life unravel in the spotlight and attracts the interest of a down-and-out reporter.
A French playboy and an American former nightclub singer fall in love aboard a ship.
After 25 years of a good marriage, what will Darcy do once she discovers her husband's sinister secret?
A worldwide epidemic encourages a biotech company to launch an organ-financing program similar in nature to a standard car loan. The repossession clause is a killer, however.

Rick, still in his 30's, works full-time as a lifeguard on the beaches of Los Angeles. When he meets his divorced high school girlfriend and her five-year-old son after fifteen years, he considers switching to a more "serious" job.
Story about three generations of men: pervert that constantly seeks for new kinds of satisfaction, an obese speed eater and a passionate embalmer.
Two men, working as professional boxers, come to blows when their careers each begin to take different directions.

After being recruited by a group of unconventional thieves, renowned criminal Richard Pace finds himself caught up in an elaborate gold heist that promises to have far-reaching implications on his life and the lives of countless others.
A boy in Nazi Germany, trying to conceal that he is Jewish, joins the Hitler Youth.

The story focuses on Aurora, a Portuguese worker in a Scottish warehouse, navigating loneliness and alienation in an algorithm-driven gig economy as she seeks meaning and connection amidst solitude and workplace confines.

The Smurfs team up with their human friends to rescue Smurfette, who has been abducted by Gargamel, since she knows a secret spell that can turn the evil sorcerer's newest creation, creatures called "The Naughties", into real Smurfs.
A team of scam artists get more than they bargained for when a job at a haunted country estate gets out of hand.
The Russian government hires the veterans of the Police Academy (1984) to help deal with the Mafia.

Anna cares for her aging parents in a fragile balance of meeting one another's needs. When a Florida heat wave shatters their family and Anna's routine, her future is uncertain until she creates a world where she can thrive.

Taking the leap out of the classic folklore, the story is set in today's time in Kashmir where Laila Majnu have problems relevant to the youth of today. While dealing with their feuding families a passionate love story unravels.
